definition_zh: 转移；调动；转学；转让；换乘；转账
definition_en: to move someone or something from one place, job, or owner to another
core_image: 一箱行李被人从一辆车搬上另一辆车，位置变了，东西没变
scene: 开学一周后，教务处通知他可以去另一个校区读同样的专业。He applied to transfer to the campus nearer his home.
sceneCN: 这里 transfer 是「转学」（第 4 个义项：从一所学校转到另一所）；句意为他申请转到离家更近的校区。画面里有教务处窗口与两个校区的指示牌。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ence 构成名词，义为「转移；移转」
由动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可转移的；可转让的」
由动词加 -ee 构成，义为「受让人；被调动者」

senses.title: To move something from one place to another
senses.definition: to move a person or thing from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物从一个地方搬到另一个地方
senses.example: They transferred the files to a new cabinet.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把档案搬到了一个新柜子里。
senses.why: Latin ferre means to carry, and trans- means across, so the verb is simply to carry across.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ferre 意为搬运，trans- 意为跨过，动词本义就是「搬过去」。

senses.title: To move money between accounts
senses.definition: to send money from one account or person to another
senses.definitionCN: 把钱从一个账户或一个人转到另一个
senses.example: Please transfer the deposit before Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 请在周五前把定金转过来。
senses.why: Money is carried across from one account to another, so the oldest physical sense fits exactly.
senses.whyCN: 钱被从一端「搬」到另一端，最古老的字面义正好贴合。

senses.title: To move to a different job or branch
senses.definition: to be moved officially to another post, office, or department
senses.definitionCN: 被正式调到另一个岗位、办事处或部门
senses.example: She was transferred to the Shanghai office in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她春天被调到上海办事处。
senses.why: A worker carried from one post to another is the same crossing, only of people instead of boxes.
senses.whyCN: 人被从一岗「搬」到另一岗，同样是跨越，只是搬的是人不是箱子。

senses.title: To change schools or courses
senses.definition: to move from one school, college, or course to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一所学校、学院或课程转到另一个
senses.example: He hopes to transfer to a university nearer home.
senses.exampleCN: 他希望转到离家更近的大学。
senses.why: Students carry their credits across institutions, so the school sense is a special case of the general one.
senses.whyCN: 学生把学分带到另一所学校，所以学校义项是一般义项的特例。

senses.title: To hand over ownership or rights
senses.definition: to give the legal ownership of something to another person
senses.definitionCN: 把某物的合法所有权交给他人
senses.example: The old man transferred the land to his daughter.
senses.exampleCN: 老人把土地转给了女儿。
senses.why: Ownership can also be carried across from one name to another, which is why lawyers use the word.
senses.whyCN: 所有权也能从一个人名下「搬」到另一个人名下，所以法律上常用这个词。

senses.title: To change from one vehicle to another
senses.definition: to get off one bus or train and continue on another
senses.definitionCN: 下了一趟公交或地铁，改乘另一趟继续
senses.example: Transfer at the third stop and take the line going east.
senses.exampleCN: 在第三站换乘往东的那条线。
senses.why: The passenger is carried across from one line to another, keeping the same journey.
senses.whyCN: 乘客被从一条线「带」到另一条线，行程却是同一段。

intro.en: Transfer comes from Latin transferre, to carry across, built from trans-, across, and ferre, to bear or carry.
intro.cn: transfer 来自拉丁语 transferre（搬运过去），由 trans-（跨过）与 ferre（承载）构成。

items.en: Ferre means to bear or carry, and its forms appear throughout English in words of carrying and offering.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ferre 意为承载、搬运，其各种形式遍布英语中表示搬运与提供的词。

items.en: Transferre means to carry across, to translate, and also to put off to another time.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transferre 意为搬运过去、翻译，也表示把事情推到另一个时间。

items.en: The noun transferre becomes translatus in the participle, which gives the English word translate.
items.cn: 其分词形式 translatus 后来生出了英语的 translate。

items.en: Old French transferer keeps the sense of moving a thing or a right from one holder to another.
items.cn: 古法语 transferer 保留了把物品或权利从一方转到另一方的含义。

items.en: English takes the word in the fourteenth century, first for moving rights and property.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入此词，最初用于移转权利与财产。

items.en: Later senses follow the railways and the banks: changing trains, then moving money between accounts.
items.cn: 后来的义项随铁路与银行而来：先是换乘，再是账户间的转账。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the trans- prefix and ferre stem, while the near-meaning group gathers verbs of moving and handing over.
note.cn: 形近组共用 trans- 前缀与 ferre 词干，近义组汇集表示移动与移交的动词。

normalIntro.en: The word is a transparent Latin compound, so learning ferre once pays off many times.
normalIntro.cn: 这是个透明的拉丁复合词，把 ferre 记一次可用在很多地方。

normal.en: Trans- is the same as in transport and translate, all meaning across.
normal.cn: trans- 与 transport、translate 中是同一个，都表示「跨过」。

normal.en: Ferre means carry, so transfer is carry across, nothing more.
normal.cn: ferre 意为搬运，所以 transfer 就是「搬过去」，别无他意。

normal.en: Other ferre words: offer, prefer, refer, suffer, all about bearing something.
normal.cn: 其他 ferre 词：offer、prefer、refer、suffer，都与「承受、带来」有关。

normal.en: Spelling note: the final r doubles before a vowel, as in transferred and transferring.
normal.cn: 拼写提示：接元音词尾时词尾 r 要双写，如 transferred、transferring。

normal.en: As a noun the stress falls forward, TRANS-fer, while the verb says trans-FER.
normal.cn: 作名词时重音在前（TRANS-fer），作动词时重音在后（trans-FER）。

abstract.en: Picture a suitcase lifted from the trunk of one car into another, the same case in a new boot.
abstract.cn: 想象一只行李箱从一辆车的后备箱被抬进另一辆，箱子没变，位置变了。

abstract.en: Now let the suitcase become a sum of money moving between two computer screens.
abstract.cn: 再让这只箱子变成一笔钱，在两块屏幕之间移动。

abstract.en: Finally see a passenger stepping off one train and onto the one across the platform.
abstract.cn: 最后看到一位乘客下一趟车，走上对面站台的那一趟。

examples.en: She transferred a thousand yuan into her son's account.
examples.cn: 她往儿子的账户里转了一千元。

examples.en: He was transferred to the night shift without warning.
examples.cn: 他在毫无预警的情况下被调到夜班。

examples.en: You can transfer at the next station to the airport line.
examples.cn: 你可以在下一站换乘机场线。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯佛」——穿过一道门，佛把东西递到对面，就是转移。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨过）+ ferre（承载；搬运），名词 trans- + ferre；同族有 transport、translate、refer、offer

sensesIntro.en: Every sense is one act of carrying something across a boundary, whether goods, money, a job, a school, a title, or a platform.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都是把某样东西搬过一道界限：货物、钱、岗位、学校、产权或站台。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a load lifted across from one place, holder, or line to another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件东西被抬过界限，从一处、一人或一条线到另一处。

branches.en: The physical family: goods and money carried from one place or account to another.
branches.cn: 实体一族：货物与钱被搬到另一处或另一账户。

branches.en: The career family: a worker moved to a new post, a student to a new school.
branches.cn: 职业一族：员工调到新岗位，学生转到新学校。

branches.en: The legal sense, where what crosses is ownership rather than an object.
branches.cn: 法律义：跨过去的是所有权，而不是实物。

branches.en: The travel sense, where the passenger crosses between two lines.
branches.cn: 出行义：乘客在两条线路之间跨越。

branches.en: Both are abstract crossings, one of value, one of right, and both keep the physical image.
branches.cn: 两者都是抽象跨越，一个跨价值，一个跨权利，而实体画面都还保留着。

intro.en: A Latin prefix plus a Latin verb stem, unchanged for two thousand years in meaning.
intro.cn: 一个拉丁前缀加一个拉丁动词词干，两千年来含义几乎没变。

latinIntro.en: Trans- and ferre are both highly productive, and recognising them unlocks a large family.
latinIntro.cn: trans- 与 ferre 都极能产，认出两者就能打开一大族词。

items.example: Transatlantic means across the Atlantic.
items.exampleCN: transatlantic 意为跨越大西洋的。

items.example: The stem appears in refer and prefer.
items.exampleCN: 该词干出现在 refer 与 prefer 中。

items.example: A ticket is transferable to another date.
items.exampleCN: 车票可以改到另一个日期使用。

items.example: The transferee signs the deed.
She translated the letter into English.

items.meaning: to carry from place to place
items.example: Trucks transport grain to the port.

items.meaning: to carry back, to point to
items.example: The note refers to page ten.
They offered him a new contract.
items.exampleCN: 他们给他提供了一份新合同。

definition_zh: 朝；向；对于；接近（某时间）；为了
definition_en: in the direction of someone or something, or in relation to them
core_image: 一根伸出的手指，指向远处的一个点
scene: 雨后有人站在山脊上，抬起手指向山谷里那座亮着灯的小村。She walked towards the lights without saying anything.
sceneCN: 这里 towards 是「朝、向」（第 1 个义项：表示方向）；句意为她什么也没说，朝着那片灯光走去。

derivatives.zh: 去掉词尾 -s 的另一种拼法，义同「朝；向」，美式更常用
古旧同义词，由 -ward 类方向词演变而来，义为「向；对」

senses.title: In the direction of something
senses.definition: moving or pointing in the direction of a person, place, or thing
senses.definitionCN: 移动或指向某人、某地或某物所在的方向
senses.example: He nodded towards the door and we followed him out.
senses.exampleCN: 他朝门口抬了抬下巴，我们就跟着他出去了。
senses.why: The word is a direction marker built on the old suffix -ward, so its first job is simply to point.
senses.whyCN: 本词是建立在古老后缀 -ward 上的方向标记，因此它最基本的任务就是「指」。

senses.title: In relation to a feeling or attitude
senses.definition: concerning the way one feels about someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 关于对某人或某物的感受方式
senses.example: Her attitude towards the plan changed after the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 会后她对这项计划的态度变了。
senses.why: Feelings also have a direction: they are aimed at a person, so the same pointing word covers emotion.
senses.whyCN: 情感也有方向：它指向某个人，所以同一个指方向的词也覆盖情感。

senses.title: Near a point in time
senses.definition: shortly before a stated hour, day, or period
senses.definitionCN: 在所说的时刻、日子或时期稍前
senses.example: Towards midday the wind dropped and the boats went out.
senses.exampleCN: 快到正午时风小了，船出海了。
senses.why: Approaching a place in space turns easily into approaching a moment in time.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的靠近很容易转为时间上的临近。

senses.title: As a contribution to a purpose
senses.definition: used of money or effort given to help reach a goal
senses.definitionCN: 用于为达成目标而付出的钱或力气
senses.example: Everyone put ten pounds towards the present.
senses.exampleCN: 每个人都为这份礼物出了十英镑。
senses.why: When effort is directed towards a goal, the direction marker becomes a word of purpose.
senses.whyCN: 当力气朝着目标使去，方向标记就变成了表示目的的词。

senses.title: Facing someone in behaviour
senses.definition: used to describe how one acts in dealing with another person
senses.definitionCN: 用于描述与某人打交道时的做法
senses.example: He was always fair towards the younger workers.
senses.exampleCN: 他对年轻工人一向公平。
senses.why: Attitude and action both aim at someone, and English groups them under one directional preposition.
senses.whyCN: 态度与行为都瞄准某个人，英语把它们归在同一个方向介词之下。

intro.en: Towards is an old English compound of the preposition to and the suffix -ward, which marks direction; the final -s was added by analogy with words like afterwards.
intro.cn: towards 是古英语的合成词，由介词 to 与表示方向的后缀 -ward 组成；词尾的 -s 是仿 afterwards 一类词加上的。

items.en: Toweard is formed from to plus the suffix -weard, meaning turned in the direction of.
items.cn: 古英语 toweard 由 to 加上后缀 -weard 构成，意为「朝向……转过去的」。

items.en: The form settles into toward, still written both as one word and as two in the manuscripts.
items.cn: 形式固定为 toward，手稿中既有连写也有分开的写法。

items.en: The suffix -weard is related to Latin vertere, to turn, through a common older root of turning.
items.cn: 一般认为后缀 -weard 经由共同的更古老「转动」词根，与拉丁语 vertere（转）相关。

items.en: In the sixteenth century a plural-looking -s is added, following the pattern of afterwards and forwards.
items.cn: 十六世纪仿照 afterwards、forwards 的模式，加上一个看似复数的 -s。

items.en: British writers keep towards, American usage prefers toward, and both are now standard.
items.cn: 英国写作 towards，美国更常用 toward，如今两种都是标准形式。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers other direction words built with -ward, and the near-meaning group gathers prepositions that also point.
note.cn: 形近组收集同样由 -ward 构成的方向词，近义组收集同样表示指向的介词。

entries.definition: the same word without the final s
entries.definitionCN: 去掉词尾 s 的同义拼法

entries.definition: in the direction ahead
in the direction behind
in the direction of home
in the direction of
to a position inside something

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the -ward family, from the to-plus-ward structure, and from the common collocations.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从 -ward 词族、to 加 ward 的结构以及常用搭配入手。

normal.en: To plus ward: to marks the target, ward marks the turning, so together they give a pointed aim.
normal.cn: to 加 ward：to 标出目标，ward 标出转向，合起来就是有指向的瞄准。

normal.en: Forward, backward, homeward, toward: the -ward family is a row of arrows.
normal.cn: forward、backward、homeward、toward，这一族词是一排箭头。

normal.en: The American spelling drops the s, so toward is the shorter arrow.
normal.cn: 美式拼法去掉 s，所以 toward 是更短的那支箭头。

normal.en: Attitude towards and contribution towards show how the arrow turns from space into feeling and money.
normal.cn: attitude towards 与 contribution towards 显示箭头如何从空间转为感情和金钱。

normal.en: Towards evening is the arrow moving along a clock rather than a map.
normal.cn: towards evening 是箭头沿着时钟而不是地图移动。

abstract.en: Picture a finger extended while the rest of the hand stays still.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸出食指，其余部分保持不动。

abstract.en: Think of a compass needle that can point at a person as easily as at a place.
abstract.cn: 想一根指南针，它可以指向一个人，也可以指向一个地方。

abstract.en: Towards is the moment of turning before the step is taken.
abstract.cn: towards 是迈步之前那一下转身。

examples.en: The dog ran towards the gate as soon as it heard the car.
examples.cn: 狗一听到车声就朝大门跑去。

examples.en: Their attitude towards newcomers has softened.
examples.cn: 他们对待新来者的态度已缓和。

examples.en: Towards the end of the film the screen goes dark.
examples.cn: 接近影片结尾时银幕暗了下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特沃兹」——特地把手往回一拉再往前一指，指向沃土那一边。

root: 古英语 to（到、向）+ -weard（朝向……的）→ toweard → 中古英语 toward → 近代加 -s 成为 towards。同族词有 toward、forward、backward、homeward。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts as a pure arrow of space and then lets that arrow travel: it aims at people as attitude, at hours as proximity, and at goals as purpose.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词起初是纯粹的空间箭头，然后让这支箭头延伸：瞄准人是态度，瞄准钟点是临近，瞄准目标是目的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow turning to face a target.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支箭头转过来，正对目标。

branches.en: The plain arrow of direction.
The arrow aimed at people as feeling and conduct.
branches.cn: 箭头指向人，成为感情与行为。

branches.en: The arrow approaching an hour.
The arrow aimed at a goal via money or effort.
branches.cn: 箭头通过钱或力气指向目标。

branches.en: The arrow in its physical form, restarting the circle.
branches.cn: 箭头回到物理形态，使语义环闭合。

intro.en: The word is built from the native preposition to and the directional suffix -ward, later extended by -s.
intro.cn: 本词由本土介词 to 与方向后缀 -ward 构成，后来又加上 -s。

latinIntro.en: The English word is native, but the suffix is distantly related to Latin vertere, to turn.
latinIntro.cn: 本词属英语本土词源，但该后缀与拉丁语 vertere（转动）有远亲关系。

items.example: To marks the target of the arrow.
The suffix builds forward and backward.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成 forward 和 backward。

items.example: Towards follows the pattern of afterwards.
items.exampleCN: towards 仿照 afterwards 的模式。

items.meaning: in the manner or direction of
items.example: Clockwise is a cousin of the same family.
Farther and further use the same directional habit.
items.exampleCN: farther 与 further 用同样的方向习惯。

items.example: The Latin stem underlies reverse and convert.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词干支撑 reverse 与 convert。

items.example: Reverse means to turn back.
Convert means to turn together into something else.
items.exampleCN: convert 意为转到另一形态。

definition_zh: 毛巾；手巾；浴巾；纸巾
definition_en: a piece of thick cloth used for drying your body, hands, or dishes
core_image: 一条搭在木架上、还在滴水的厚布
scene: 洗完手之后水还在往下淌，架子上的厚布被拿起来按在掌心。He reached for the towel and wiped his hands twice.
sceneCN: 这里 towel 是「毛巾、手巾」（第 1 个义项：用于擦干身体或手的一块厚布）；句意为他拿起毛巾把手擦了两遍。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「毛巾布；毛巾料」
由过去分词转化，义为「用毛巾擦干的」

senses.title: Cloth for drying the hands or face
senses.definition: a small thick cloth kept by a basin for wiping wet hands or face
senses.definitionCN: 放在盆边用来擦干湿手或脸的小块厚布
senses.example: There is a clean towel hanging beside the sink.
senses.exampleCN: 水槽旁边挂着一条干净的毛巾。
senses.why: The word names the cloth that does the drying, and this household use is the oldest everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本指执行擦干动作的那块布，这种家常用途是最古老的日常义项。

senses.title: The large cloth used after a bath
senses.definition: a big towel that wraps the whole body after washing
senses.definitionCN: 洗完澡后能裹住整个身体的大毛巾
senses.example: She came out of the shower wrapped in a towel.
senses.exampleCN: 她裹着浴巾从淋浴间走出来。
senses.why: The same cloth grows to body size, and English simply keeps the one word for both sizes.
senses.whyCN: 同一种布长大到身体尺寸，英语仍用一个词兼指两种规格。

senses.title: A disposable paper square
senses.definition: a sheet of absorbent paper used once for drying or wiping
senses.definitionCN: 一次性使用、用来擦干的吸水纸
senses.example: He grabbed a paper towel to mop up the spilled coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 他抽了一张纸巾去擦洒出来的咖啡。
senses.why: When paper took over the drying job, the old cloth name simply moved onto it with paper in front.
senses.whyCN: 当纸接过擦干的任务，旧的布名只要前面加个 paper 就直接移用过去了。

senses.title: To rub dry with a towel
senses.definition: to rub a person, animal, or object dry with a towel
senses.definitionCN: 用毛巾把人、动物或物体擦干
senses.example: She toweled her hair quickly and ran for the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 她匆匆把头发擦干就往公交站跑。
senses.why: Any tool can be turned into a verb, so the cloth becomes the action of using it.
senses.whyCN: 任何工具都能转为动词，于是这块布就成了「用它」这个动作。

senses.title: Surrender in the idiom
senses.definition: in the phrase throw in the towel, to admit defeat and stop trying
senses.definitionCN: 在短语 throw in the towel 中表示承认失败、停止努力
senses.example: After three failed attempts he threw in the towel.
senses.exampleCN: 三次尝试失败后，他认输了。
senses.why: A boxer's corner threw a towel into the ring to end the fight, so the cloth came to mean giving up.
senses.whyCN: 拳击台的教练往擂台上扔毛巾表示终止比赛，于是这条布就成了「放弃」的意思。

intro.en: Towel comes from Old French toaille, a cloth for washing, which goes back to a Germanic word for a washing cloth, probably influenced in form by Latin words for cloth.
intro.cn: towel 来自古法语 toaille（洗涤用的布），其更早来源是日耳曼语表示「擦洗布」的词，词形大概受拉丁语中表示布的词影响。

items.en: A Germanic word for a washing cloth, related to the verb to wash, is generally taken as the ultimate source.
items.cn: 一般认为其最终来源是日耳曼语中表示「洗涤布」的词，与表示「洗」的动词相关。

items.en: Frankish speech carries the word into Old French, where it appears as toaille with the meaning bath cloth.
items.cn: 法兰克人的语言把这个词带进古法语，写成 toaille，意为「浴布」。

items.en: Medieval Latin documents use toallia and tuallia for table and hand cloths, likely borrowed back from the French form.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁文献用 toallia、tuallia 指桌布和擦手布，大概又是从法语形式借回去的。

items.en: English adopts the word as towaille and later settles on towel for the cloth kept by the basin.
items.cn: 英语先写成 towaille，后来固定为 towel，指放在盆边的擦布。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the word attaches to paper sheets, and the boxing phrase throw in the towel appears.
items.cn: 十九世纪这个词用到纸制品上，拳击习语 throw in the towel 也在这时出现。

items.en: The verb to towel develops in the same period from the noun, first for people then for dogs and hair.
items.cn: 动词 towel 也在同一时期由名词发展出来，先指擦人，后指擦狗和头发。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that share the ending or the towel-like shape, and the near-meaning group gathers cloths used in the bathroom or kitchen.
note.cn: 形近组收集词尾相同或形状像毛巾的词，近义组则收入浴室与厨房用的布。

soft cloth used for washing the face
a cloth or paper used at meals
soft paper used for wiping the nose

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the way the word has moved from cloth to paper and from noun to verb.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从本词「由布到纸、由名词到动词」的迁移方式入手。

normal.en: Bath towel, hand towel, paper towel: the material or the use goes in front of the same cloth.
normal.cn: bath towel、hand towel、paper towel，材料或用途一律放在这块布前面。

normal.en: The -el ending is the same as in the borrowed French cloth words, not a suffix of meaning.
normal.cn: 词尾 -el 和借入的法语布名一样，只是形式，不表示意义。

normal.en: Towel can be a verb because every tool can become the act of using it.
normal.cn: towel 可以作动词，因为每件工具都能变成使用它的动作。

normal.en: Throw in the towel comes from boxing corners, where a thrown cloth ended the fight.
normal.cn: throw in the towel 来自拳击教练席，被扔出的布会终止比赛。

normal.en: Paper towel shows the word's willingness to change material: cloth first, paper later.
normal.cn: paper towel 显示这个词乐于更换材质：先是布，后来是纸。

abstract.en: Picture a wet hand and the white square that turns it dry in two seconds.
abstract.cn: 想象一只湿手和那块两秒就把它擦白的方布。

abstract.en: Think of a towel on a rail, still heavy with the last person's water.
abstract.cn: 想一条搭在架上的毛巾，还带着上一位使用者的水。

abstract.en: A towel is a small borrowed dryness that you hand back after use.
abstract.cn: 毛巾是可以借用、用完还回去的一小块「干」。

examples.en: Pass me a towel, please.
examples.cn: 请递给我一条毛巾。

examples.en: He toweled the dog dry at the door.
examples.cn: 他在门口把狗擦干了。

examples.en: After two hours of arguing, she threw in the towel.
examples.cn: 争了两个小时后，她认输了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「套哦」——把手套进去擦干，哦，水全没了。

root: 日耳曼语「擦洗布」（与「洗」的动词相关）→ 法兰克语 → 古法语 toaille → 中古英语 towaille → 英语 towel。同族词有 towelling、toweled。

sensesIntro.en: The entry follows one cloth through its sizes and materials, then through its change from noun to verb, and ends at the boxing ring where the same cloth means defeat.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词跟随同一块布，走过不同尺寸与材质，再由名词转为动词，最后来到拳击台上，用同一块布表示认输。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick absorbent cloth held against wet skin.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块厚而吸水的布贴在湿皮肤上。

branches.en: The small cloth beside the basin.
The body-sized cloth after a bath.
The paper version of the drying cloth.
The cloth turned into an action.
The thrown cloth that ends a fight.
branches.cn: 被扔出去终止比赛的布。

intro.en: The word is a borrowing without a productive English suffix, but its members show the -el of borrowed French nouns and the -ing of the continuing form.
intro.cn: 本词是借词，没有能产的英语后缀，但词族里能看出法语借入名词的 -el 与持续体的 -ing。

latinIntro.en: Medieval Latin records the word as toallia, borrowed back from French, so the Latin entries are the documentary forms rather than true roots.
latinIntro.cn: 中世纪拉丁文献把这个词记作 toallia，是从法语借回去的，因此下面的拉丁词条是文献形式而非真正词根。

items.example: Toaille is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: toaille 是英语本词的直接来源。

items.example: The ending appears in borrowed cloth names.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾出现在借入的布名中。

items.example: Towelling is the cloth the towel is made of.
Toweled is the past of the verb.
Bath towel is the large size.
Hand towel is the small size.
Paper towel replaces cloth with sheet.
items.exampleCN: paper towel 用纸片替代布。

items.meaning: a bar to hang things on
items.example: A towel rail holds the cloths.

latinEntries.meaning: a variant form of the same cloth word
latinEntries.meaningCN: 同一布名词的变体形式

definition_zh: 塔；高楼；塔楼；（作动词）高耸；远远高出
definition_en: a tall narrow structure or building that stands far above what is around it
core_image: 一座瘦高的石塔，从周围的屋顶里直插上去
scene: 黄昏的旧城，屋顶一片低矮，只有教堂的石砌高塔越过了所有屋脊。The clock tower can be seen from the harbour on a clear evening.
sceneCN: 这里 tower 是「塔」（第 1 个义项：高而窄的建筑物）；句意为天气晴好的傍晚从港湾就能望见那座钟塔。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「高耸的；极其高大的」
由过去分词转化，义为「有塔楼的」
来自同一拉丁词源的小词，义为「小塔；角楼」

senses.title: A tall narrow structure
senses.definition: a building or structure much taller than it is wide, often used for watching, bells, or water
senses.definitionCN: 高度远大于宽度的建筑或结构，常用于瞭望、敲钟或储水
senses.example: The tower has stood on the hill for six hundred years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座塔已在山上矗立了六百年。
senses.why: The Latin source names a tower, and this is the plain architectural sense still at the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源本身就是「塔」，这是这个词至今居中心位置的建筑本义。

senses.title: A high building of many floors
senses.definition: a tall building with many storeys, especially one for offices or flats
senses.definitionCN: 层数很多的建筑，尤指办公楼或住宅
senses.example: They work on the twentieth floor of that tower.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在那座高楼的二十层上班。
senses.why: When cities grew upward, the tall vertical shape of the stone tower was simply reused for new buildings.
senses.whyCN: 当城市向上生长时，石塔那种高而直的形态就被直接套用到新建筑上。

senses.title: To rise far above the surroundings
senses.definition: used of something that stands much taller than the things near it
senses.definitionCN: 指某物比周围的东西高得多
senses.example: The old tree towers over the garden wall.
senses.exampleCN: 那棵老树高过花园的围墙。
senses.why: A building so vertical becomes a gesture, and the noun turns into a verb for standing tall.
senses.whyCN: 建筑如此竖直就变成了一种姿态，名词便转为「站得高」的动词。

senses.title: To be far greater in another quality
senses.definition: to be far greater than someone or something in ability, size, or importance
senses.definitionCN: 在能力、规模或重要性上远远超过某人或某物
senses.example: In debate she towers over her opponents.
senses.exampleCN: 在辩论中她远远胜过对手。
senses.why: Height is the easiest metaphor for excellence, so towering over rivals means being much greater.
senses.whyCN: 「高」是形容卓越最容易的比喻，所以高于对手就是远胜对手。

senses.title: A place of proud distance
senses.definition: in phrases like ivory tower, a protected place far from ordinary life
senses.definitionCN: 如 ivory tower 一类说法中，指远离日常生活的保护区
senses.example: Critics say the scholars have retired to an ivory tower.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者说这些学者退进了象牙塔。
senses.why: A tower keeps its people above the street and away from it, so the image comes to mean proud isolation.
senses.whyCN: 塔让人位于街道之上并与之隔绝，于是这个形象转指高傲的自我隔离。

intro.en: Tower comes from Latin turris through Old French tor, and the same Latin noun gave Greek island towns such as Tower names across Europe; the more distant origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: tower 经古法语 tor 来自拉丁语 turris；更深来源不确定。同一个拉丁名词在整个欧洲派生出了众多塔名。

items.en: Greek tyrris is cited as a forerunner of the Latin word, but the link is debated.
items.cn: 一般认为希腊语 tyrris 是拉丁词的先形，但这层联系仍有争议。

items.en: Latin turris names a tall fortified structure, and it is borrowed by many languages of the empire.
items.cn: 拉丁语 turris 指高耸的防御性建筑，被帝国境内的许多语言借走。

items.en: Old French tor and tur keep the military sense and pass into the language of castles.
items.cn: 古法语 tor、tur 保留了军事含义，进入城堡用语。

items.en: Middle English tower first means a castle keep or a church bell tower.
items.cn: 中古英语 tower 最初指城堡主楼或教堂钟楼。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries the word widens to office blocks and water works.
items.cn: 十九、二十世纪，这个词扩展到办公楼与供水设施。

items.en: The figurative ivory tower becomes common after French criticism of writers in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪法国人批评作家脱离现实之后，比喻性的 ivory tower 才流行起来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words easily confused in spelling with tower, and the near-meaning group gathers tall vertical things.
note.cn: 形近组收集拼写易与 tower 混淆的词，近义组收集高而竖直的事物。

entries.definitionCN: 拖；牵引，只是拼写相近，词源不同

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the Latin stem, from the castle and water compounds, and from the verb of standing tall.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从拉丁词干、城堡与储水的复合词，以及「高耸」的动词用法入手。

normal.en: Turris is the Latin tower, and it stands behind turret as well.
normal.cn: turris 是拉丁语的塔，turret 也由它而来。

normal.en: Clock tower, water tower, tower block: the word sits in front to say what the tall thing is for.
normal.cn: clock tower、water tower、tower block，本词放前面说明这座高物是做什么用的。

normal.en: The verb use is easy: towers over simply means stands much taller than.
normal.cn: 动词用法很简单：towers over 就是「比……高得多地立着」。

normal.en: Ivory tower is a set phrase and its meaning is isolation, not height.
normal.cn: ivory tower 是固定说法，重点在隔离，不在高度。

normal.en: Tower and towel differ by one letter, so remember the tower has an r for rock.
normal.cn: tower 与 towel 只差一个字母，记住塔有 r，r 代表石头。

abstract.en: Picture a thin grey finger of stone poking above a whole town of roofs.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细细的灰色石指，从全城的屋顶上方伸出来。

abstract.en: Think of a shadow that is long at sunset because the thing casting it is so tall.
abstract.cn: 想日落时那道很长的影子，因为投下影子的东西太高了。

abstract.en: A tower is height that has been made permanent.
abstract.cn: 塔是被固定下来的高度。

examples.en: The water tower supplies the whole village.
examples.cn: 这座水塔为整个村子供水。

examples.en: He towers over everyone in his class.
examples.cn: 他比班上所有人都高出一截。

examples.en: The tower was struck by lightning last summer.
examples.cn: 去年夏天这座塔被雷击中了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「塔窝」——塔里有个窝，抬头看塔，越看越高。

root: 拉丁语 turris（塔）→ 古法语 tor → 中古英语 tower。同族或同源词有 turret；更早的希腊语来源一般认为相关，但尚未定论。

sensesIntro.en: From one upright stone shape the entry rises into the modern high building, then tilts into the verb of being taller, then into superiority, and finally into the tower as a place of proud isolation.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一块竖直的石头形态出发，本词长成现代高楼，再倾斜为「更高」的动词，进而表示优越，最后成为高傲隔离之所。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow vertical stone rising above everything around it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座窄而竖直的石构物，高出周围一切。

branches.en: The fort or bell structure itself.
The modern high building.
The act of standing much higher.
The metaphor of superiority.
The tower as a place apart from the world.
branches.cn: 作为远离尘世之处的塔。

intro.en: The word is a simple borrowing from Latin with no productive English suffix, and its compounds are built by putting the purpose in front.
intro.cn: 本词是直接借入的拉丁词，没有能产的英语后缀，其复合词靠把用途前置来构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin noun turris is the source of the English word and of its diminutive cousin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁名词 turris 既是英语本词的来源，也是它的指小近亲的来源。

items.example: The stem gives tower and turret.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干给出 tower 与 turret。

items.meaning: no meaning of its own here
items.example: The French ending becomes -er in English.
items.exampleCN: 法语词尾在英语中变为 -er。

items.example: Turret is a small tower.
Towering means standing tall.
Towered means having towers.
A clock tower holds the town clock.
A water tower holds the supply.
A tower block is a high block of flats.
items.exampleCN: tower block 是高层公寓楼。

items.example: Ivory tower is the phrase of isolation.
items.exampleCN: ivory tower 是表示隔离的说法。

definition_zh: 城镇；市镇；城里；商业中心区
definition_en: a place with many houses, shops, and streets, larger than a village but usually smaller than a city
core_image: 一条街连着一条街，中间有广场和集市的聚集地
scene: 周六早晨，广场上支起了一排卖菜的棚子，熟人和陌生人混在一起走。The whole town turns out for the market on Saturday.
sceneCN: 这里 town 是「城镇」（第 1 个义项：比村庄大、比城市小的人类聚居地）；句意为周六整个镇子的人都出来赶集。

derivatives.zh: 由 town 加 people 构成，义为「镇上居民」
由 town 加 -ship 构成，义为「镇区；乡」
由 town 加 -ie 构成，口语指「镇上人」

senses.title: A settlement larger than a village
senses.definition: a place where many people live and work, with shops and streets, but not as big as a city
senses.definitionCN: 许多人居住和工作的地方，有商店和街道，但不如城市大
senses.example: The town grew slowly around the river crossing.
senses.exampleCN: 这个镇子沿着渡口慢慢长大。
senses.why: The oldest sense is an enclosed settlement, and the fence that once made it a unit still shapes the idea of it.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是有围护的聚居地，那道曾使它成为一体的围墙至今影响着这个概念。

senses.title: The built-up centre as opposed to the countryside
senses.definition: the shopping and business part of a district, seen from the countryside around it
senses.definitionCN: 一个地区的商业与办事区域，相对于周围的乡村而言
senses.example: We drove into town to buy paint and a new lamp.
senses.exampleCN: 我们进城去买油漆和一盏新灯。
senses.why: People living outside mark the centre as their centre, so town becomes a place one goes into rather than a whole place.
senses.whyCN: 住在外面的人把中心当作自己的中心，于是 town 成为「要去的地方」，而不是一整块地方。

senses.title: The people of a town taken together
senses.definition: the inhabitants of a place regarded as one group
senses.definitionCN: 把某地居民视为一个整体
senses.example: The whole town came to see the fire engine.
senses.exampleCN: 全镇的人都来看那辆消防车。
senses.why: A place name can stand for its people, so the word shifts from streets to the crowd on them.
senses.whyCN: 地名可以代表居民，于是这个词从「街道」转到街上的「人群」。

senses.title: The place one belongs to
senses.definition: in phrases like home town, the place where a person grew up
senses.definitionCN: 如 home town 一类说法中，指一个人长大的地方
senses.example: He returned to his home town after twenty years in the navy.
senses.exampleCN: 他在海军待了二十年后回到家乡。
senses.why: Because a town holds a person's early life, it becomes a marker of identity rather than a mere location.
senses.whyCN: 因为镇子承载了一个人的早年生活，它就成了身份的标志，而不只是地点。

senses.title: Urban life as a manner
senses.definition: used before other nouns to describe customs and habits of urban living
senses.definitionCN: 放在其他名词前，描述城市生活的习俗与习惯
senses.example: Town life suited her better than the quiet farms.
senses.exampleCN: 比起安静的农场，城市生活更适合她。
senses.why: The noun in front position turns into a style label, describing a way of living rather than a spot on the map.
senses.whyCN: 名词放在前位就变成风格标签，描述的是一种生活方式，而不是地图上的一点。

intro.en: Town is one of the oldest English words and is related to Dutch tuin, garden, and to German Zaun, fence; it first meant an enclosed place.
intro.cn: town 是英语最古老的词之一，与荷兰语 tuin（园子）、德语 Zaun（篱笆）同源，最初意为「被围起来的地方」。

items.en: Old English tun means an enclosed piece of ground, a farm, or an estate, with a fence around it.
items.cn: 古英语 tun 指一块被围起来的地、农场或庄园，四周围着篱笆。

items.en: The same root gives German Zaun, a fence, and Dutch tuin, a garden, showing that enclosure was the core idea.
items.cn: 同一词根给出德语 Zaun（篱笆）和荷兰语 tuin（园子），可见「围护」是核心概念。

items.en: As settlements grew, tun came to mean a group of houses rather than a single farm.
items.cn: 随着聚居地扩大，tun 从单座农庄转指一群房屋。

items.en: By the later Middle Ages town is the ordinary word for a market settlement with a charter.
items.cn: 到中古后期，town 已成为指有特许状的集市聚居地的常用词。

items.en: From the seventeenth century town is often opposed to country, giving the phrase to go into town.
items.cn: 十七世纪起 town 常与 country 相对，于是有了 to go into town 这样的说法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words confused with town in spelling or sound, and the near-meaning group gathers kinds of settlement.
note.cn: 形近组收集拼写或读音易与 town 混淆的词，近义组收集不同类型的聚居地。

entries.definition: a unit of weight
entries.definitionCN: 吨，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: toward a lower place
entries.definitionCN: 向下，只是读音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a district of a town or a local unit of government
the people who live in a town
a small settlement in the countryside
a very large and important urban place
a residential area on the edge of a city

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the old meaning of an enclosed farm, from the compounds, and from the phrase of going into town.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「围起来的农庄」这一古老含义、复合词以及「进城」的说法入手。

normal.en: Old English tun was a fenced farm, so a town is first of all a place marked off by a boundary.
normal.cn: 古英语 tun 是围起篱笆的农庄，所以镇首先是划出边界的地方。

normal.en: German Zaun and Dutch tuin are cousins, both about enclosure.
normal.cn: 德语 Zaun 与荷兰语 tuin 是近亲，都围绕「围」这个意思。

normal.en: Town hall, town centre, home town: the word likes to stand in front of another noun.
normal.cn: town hall、town centre、home town，这个词喜欢站在另一名词前。

normal.en: Go into town works because the countryside surrounds it, not because the town has an inside.
normal.cn: go into town 成立，是因为乡村包围着它，而不是镇真有内部。

normal.en: The word is short and closed, just like the fence that started it.
normal.cn: 这个词短而封闭，正像最初围着它的那道篱笆。

abstract.en: Picture a fence, then houses inside the fence, then the fence forgotten and the houses still there.
abstract.cn: 想象一道篱笆，篱笆里的房屋，后来篱笆被忘了，房屋还在。

abstract.en: Think of a square where every person knows three others by name but not everyone.
abstract.cn: 想一个广场，每个人能叫出另外三个人的名字，却不是所有人都认识。

abstract.en: A town is a village that got busy, before it became a city that got anonymous.
abstract.cn: 镇是一个忙起来的村庄，还未变成匿名的城市。

examples.en: Our town has one cinema and two bakeries.
examples.cn: 我们镇上有一家电影院和两家面包房。

examples.en: She went into town to post the letters.
examples.cn: 她进城去寄信。

examples.en: The old town is famous for its stone bridge.
examples.cn: 这座老城以石桥闻名。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「趟」——一趟出去逛，街上到处是人，就是镇。

root: 古英语 tun（有篱笆围起的土地、农庄）→ 中古英语 town（一群房屋的聚居地）→ 现代英语 town（城镇）。同源词有德语 Zaun（篱笆）、荷兰语 tuin（园子）。

sensesIntro.en: From an enclosed farm the word grows into a settlement, then into the centre that people go into, then into the people who live there, then into the place a person belongs to, and finally into a style of life.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从围起的农庄长成聚居地，再成为人们「进去」的中心，再指其中的居民，进而指一个人归属的地方，最后成为一种生活方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ring of fence with houses gathered inside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一圈篱笆，里面聚着一群房屋。

branches.en: The settlement itself, bigger than a village.
branches.cn: 比村庄更大的聚居地本身。

branches.en: The centre that one travels into.
The inhabitants as one body.
The place that holds one's early life.
branches.cn: 承载一个人早年生活的地方。

branches.en: The urban manner of living.

intro.en: The word is a native English root with no added suffix, and its family is built with -ship, people, and the informal -ie.
intro.cn: 本词是英语本土词根，未加后缀，其词族由 -ship、people 以及口语化的 -ie 构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source for this word, so the Latin entries are empty and only the Germanic relatives are relevant.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁词条，只有日耳曼语亲缘词相关。

items.example: Tun is the oldest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: tun 是最早记录的形式。

items.example: Township names a district.
Townspeople are the residents.
Townie is informal for a town person.
items.exampleCN: townie 是镇上人的口语说法。

items.example: A town hall is the civic building.
The town centre is the middle of the place.
Home town marks where one grew up.
items.exampleCN: home town 标明长大的地方。

items.meaning: a place of buying and selling
items.example: A market town grew around trade.
items.exampleCN: 集镇围绕贸易成长起来。

definition_zh: 玩具；玩物；（作定语）玩具的；像玩具一样小的
definition_en: an object for children to play with, or something treated as a plaything rather than seriously
core_image: 地板上一个被推着走的小木车，轮子歪了一点
scene: 孩子坐在地毯上，把一只上了发条的锡皮小兔子推来推去，笑得停不下来。The broken toy was mended with tape and played with again.
sceneCN: 这里 toy 是「玩具」（第 1 个义项：供儿童玩耍的物件）；句意为那只坏掉的玩具用胶带缠好，又被玩了起来。

pos.zh: 形容词作定语：玩具的；小型的

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「摆弄；玩弄」
由 toy 加 shop 合成，义为「玩具店」

senses.title: An object made for children to play with
senses.definition: a thing such as a doll, model, or set of blocks made to be played with
senses.definitionCN: 洋娃娃、模型或积木之类专门供人玩耍的东西
senses.example: He still keeps his first toy in a wooden box.
senses.exampleCN: 他仍把第一件玩具放在一个木盒里。
senses.why: The word's oldest English sense is a plaything, and this is the meaning the whole entry grows from.
senses.whyCN: 本词在英语里最早的含义就是玩物，整个词义都从这里生长出来。

senses.title: A small imitation of a real thing
senses.definition: a small model of a vehicle, animal, or machine kept to be played with or collected
senses.definitionCN: 车辆、动物或机器的小型仿制品，用于玩耍或收藏
senses.example: His shelf is full of toy trains from different countries.
senses.exampleCN: 他的架子上摆满了各国的玩具火车。
senses.why: A toy is by nature a miniature copy, so the word doubles as a label for scaled-down models.
senses.whyCN: 玩具天生是缩小的复制品，所以这个词同时成为缩小模型的标签。

senses.title: Something treated unseriously
senses.definition: a person or thing that others use for their amusement or handle without respect
senses.definitionCN: 被别人拿来取乐或不加尊重地对待的人或物
senses.example: The treaty made the small state a toy of its neighbours.
senses.exampleCN: 这份条约让这个小国成了邻邦的玩物。
senses.why: When a thing is handled only for amusement, the plaything sense turns into a charge of disrespect.
senses.whyCN: 当一件东西只被拿来取乐，玩物之义就转为「不尊重」的指控。

senses.title: To handle something idly
senses.definition: to touch or move something about while thinking of something else
senses.definitionCN: 想着别的事时随手触碰或摆弄某物
senses.example: She toyed with her spoon while the letter was read aloud.
senses.exampleCN: 信被念出来时，她心不在焉地摆弄着勺子。
senses.why: Playing with an object becomes the verb, and the verb carries the idea of purpose without seriousness.
senses.whyCN: 把物件当作玩具这就成了动词，而这个动词带着「有动作却不当真」的意味。

senses.title: To consider an idea without deciding
senses.definition: to think about a plan or suggestion in a light, undecided way
senses.definitionCN: 轻描淡写、尚未决定地考虑某个计划或建议
senses.example: He toyed with the idea of moving north but never went.
senses.exampleCN: 他随意动过搬到北方的念头，却从未成行。
senses.why: Handling an idea the way a child handles a toy is exactly the picture behind this usage.
senses.whyCN: 像孩子摆弄玩具那样摆弄一个念头，正是这个用法背后的画面。

senses.title: The small version of a breed
senses.definition: used before a dog or other breed name to mean a very small kept variety
senses.definitionCN: 放在犬种等名称前，指非常小型的饲养品种
senses.example: A toy poodle fits easily into a city flat.
senses.exampleCN: 玩具贵宾犬很适合住在城市公寓里。
senses.why: An animal bred down to the size of a plaything inherits the word, since size is what the toy label marks.
senses.whyCN: 被培育成玩具大小的动物继承了这个词，因为玩具这个标签标记的正是尺寸。

intro.en: Toy appears in English in the fourteenth century with the sense of a foolish trifle, and its deeper origin is uncertain; the meaning of a child's plaything is later.
intro.cn: toy 在十四世纪出现于英语，最初指「无聊的小玩意儿」，更深来源不确定；「儿童玩具」这一含义是后来才有的。

items.en: The word's earlier history is not settled; it may be related to Dutch or East Frisian forms for a tool or trinket.
items.cn: 这个词更早的来源尚无定论，可能与荷兰语或东弗里西亚语中表示工具、小饰物的词形有关。

items.en: Middle English toy means a trivial thing, a trifle, or a piece of foolish talk.
items.cn: 中古英语 toy 意为琐碎之物、小事或无聊的话。

items.en: In the sixteenth century the word comes to mean an object kept for amusement rather than use.
items.cn: 十六世纪，这个词转指为消遣而非实用而留着的物件。

items.en: By the eighteenth century toy means chiefly a child's plaything, and toy shops appear in towns.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，toy 主要表示儿童玩具，城镇里出现了玩具店。

items.en: The verb to toy with, meaning to handle idly or to consider lightly, is well established in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 表示摆弄或轻率考虑的动词 to toy with 在十九世纪已完全确立。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers near neighbours in spelling and the toy family, while the near-meaning group gathers playthings and trifles.
note.cn: 形近组收集拼写相近的词以及玩具词族，近义组收集玩物与琐事。

entries.definition: to work very hard
entries.definitionCN: 辛苦劳作，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a unit of weight
entries.definitionCN: 吨，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a shop that sells playthings
the act of handling something idly
an object kept for playing
a thing of little value
a small copy of a larger object

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the original sense of a trifle, from the compounds, and from the verb to toy with.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「小玩意儿」这一原义、复合词以及动词搭配 to toy with 入手。

normal.en: Toy first meant a trifle, so a toy is something light, small, and not serious.
normal.cn: toy 最早指小玩意儿，所以玩具就是轻、小、不当真的东西。

normal.en: Toy shop, toy car, toy poodle: in front of a noun it simply says small and for play.
normal.cn: toy shop、toy car、toy poodle，放在名词前就是「小、供玩」。

normal.en: To toy with an idea is to hold it the way a hand holds a small object.
normal.cn: to toy with an idea 就是像手把玩小物件那样对待一个想法。

normal.en: The verb is regular: toys, toyed, toying.
normal.cn: 动词规则变化：toys、toyed、toying。

normal.en: A toy is the smallest possible copy of the real thing.
normal.cn: 玩具是一件真东西尽可能小的复制品。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden train running under the dining table instead of across the country.
abstract.cn: 想象一列木火车不在全国奔跑，而是在餐桌上行驶。

abstract.en: Think of a spoon turned over and over in fingers at the end of a slow meal.
abstract.cn: 想一顿慢餐末尾，一把勺子在指间翻来翻去。

abstract.en: A toy is seriousness put on hold.
abstract.cn: 玩具是被暂时搁置的认真。

examples.en: The child left her toys all over the floor.
examples.cn: 孩子把玩具撒了一地。

examples.en: He toyed with the handle of his cup during the interview.
examples.cn: 面试时他摆弄着杯子的把手。

examples.en: A toy car was stuck under the sofa.
examples.cn: 一辆玩具车卡在沙发底下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拖一」——拖着一个小东西满屋跑，就是玩具。

root: 中古英语 toy（琐碎之物、无聊话），更早来源不确定，一般认为可能与荷兰语或东弗里西亚语表示工具、小饰物的词形有关；近代转指儿童玩具。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts from a trifle, narrows to the child's plaything, widens to miniature models and to people treated as playthings, then turns into the verbs of idle handling and light consideration.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从小玩意儿出发，收窄到儿童玩具，再扩展到缩小模型与被当作玩物的人，最后转为「随手摆弄」与「轻率考虑」的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small object held in the hands just for amusement.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个只为取乐而被拿在手里的小物件。

branches.en: The thing made for play.
The scaled-down copy and the scaled-down animal.
branches.cn: 缩小的复制品与缩小的动物。

branches.en: The person or thing handled without respect.
branches.cn: 不被尊重地对待的人或物。

branches.en: The hand busy with a small object.
The mind turning an idea over lightly.
branches.cn: 心智轻轻翻动一个念头。

intro.en: The word is a short English borrowing with no true suffix, and its family is built by compounding and by the -ing and -ed endings.
intro.cn: 本词是简短借入词，没有真正的后缀，其词族靠复合以及 -ing、-ed 词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source for this word, so no Latin entries are listed and only the English forms are given.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁词条，只给出英语形式。

items.example: Toy is both noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: toy 既是名词也是动词。

items.example: Toys fill the box.
He toyed with the idea.
Toying with the lid is a habit.
A toyshop sells playthings.
A toy car is a small model.
A soft toy is stuffed with filling.
items.exampleCN: soft toy 是填塞填充物的毛绒玩具。

items.example: A toy poodle is a small breed.

definition_zh: 痕迹；踪迹；微量；（作动词）追溯；追踪；描摹
definition_en: a mark or sign left by something that has passed, or to follow such marks back to their source
core_image: 泥地上的一串脚印，一直延伸到树林里
scene: 雨后的田埂上留着一行野兽的脚印，猎狗低头嗅着，一步一步往里走。The hunters followed the trace of a deer to the edge of the marsh.
sceneCN: 这里 trace 是「踪迹、痕迹」（第 1 个义项：某物经过后留下的印记）；句意为猎人循着鹿的踪迹一直走到了沼泽边缘。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「描摹；追踪；描图纸」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「追踪者；示踪剂」
由动词加 -able 构成，义为「可追溯的」

senses.title: A mark left behind by movement
senses.definition: a sign such as footprints, a line, or a stain left by something moving or present
senses.definitionCN: 由物体移动或出现而留下的脚印、线条或污渍等记号
senses.example: There were fresh traces of mud on the kitchen floor.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房地板上留下了新鲜的泥痕。
senses.why: The Latin source is a verb of drawing a line, so a trace is what a passing line leaves behind.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源是「画线」的动词，所以痕迹就是一条经过的线所留下的东西。

senses.title: A very small amount
senses.definition: a tiny quantity of something, especially one barely detectable
senses.definitionCN: 极少的量，尤指几乎难以察觉的一点
senses.example: The water showed traces of copper from the old pipes.
senses.exampleCN: 水里检出了老管道带来的一丝铜。
senses.why: If only a mark remains of something, then only a little of it is left, and that little becomes the second sense.
senses.whyCN: 若某物只剩下一个印记，那就只剩一点点，而这一点点便成了第二个义项。

senses.title: To follow marks to their source
senses.definition: to find the origin or history of something by following the evidence
senses.definitionCN: 循着证据找出某物的起源或来历
senses.example: Scholars traced the proverb back to a Latin writer.
senses.exampleCN: 学者们把这句谚语追溯到一位拉丁作家。
senses.why: Following a line drawn by something is following its path backwards, which is what tracing an origin means.
senses.whyCN: 顺着某物画出的线走，就是反向跟随它的路径，这正是「追溯起源」的意思。

senses.title: To copy a shape by drawing over it
senses.definition: to copy a picture by placing thin paper over it and drawing the lines
senses.definitionCN: 把薄纸覆在图上，照着线条描出图形
senses.example: She traced the outline of the leaf onto the page.
senses.exampleCN: 她把叶子的轮廓描到了纸上。
senses.why: The oldest sense of the Latin verb is to draw a line, and copying a shape is the most literal drawing of lines.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词最古老的含义就是画线，而照着轮廓画线是最字面的用法。

senses.title: To find the course of something
senses.definition: to follow the path or development of something step by step
senses.definitionCN: 一步一步跟随某物的路线或发展
senses.example: They traced the river from the mountains to the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 他们从山间到大海沿途追查这条河。
senses.why: Once you have a line, you can walk along it, and the word moves from drawing a path to following one.
senses.whyCN: 一旦有了一条线，就能顺着它走，于是这个词从「画路径」转到「跟随路径」。

intro.en: Trace comes from Old French tracier, from Latin tractus, a dragging or a drawing out, which is built on the verb trahere, to pull.
intro.cn: trace 来自古法语 tracier，源自拉丁语 tractus（拖、拉出），建立在动词 trahere（拉）之上。

items.en: Trahere means to pull or draw; its participle tractus means a dragging or a drawn line.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、拖；其分词 tractus 意为「拖拽」或「画出的线」。

items.en: Old French tracier means to draw a line, to mark out a path, or to make a sketch.
items.cn: 古法语 tracier 意为画线、标出路径或勾勒草图。

items.en: English borrows the word first for a mark on the ground left by a person or animal.
items.cn: 英语先借入这个词，指人或动物留在地上的印记。

items.en: In the seventeenth century the abstract sense of tracing a story or a family back to its origin develops.
items.cn: 十七世纪发展出「把一段经过或一个家族追溯到源头」的抽象含义。

items.en: The scientific use for tiny amounts, such as trace elements, becomes standard in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
items.cn: 表示极微量的科学用法（如微量元素）在十九、二十世纪成为标准。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the Latin pulling root, while the near-meaning group gathers words for signs and for following a path.
note.cn: 形近组收集建立在拉丁语「拉」这一词根上的词，近义组收集表示记号与跟随路径的词。

entries.definition: a copy made by drawing over lines
something that follows or marks a course
a path or the marks left on it
entries.definitionCN: 轨道；足迹，拼写相近但来源不同

entries.definition: to pull something out
a visible sign on a surface
signs that show something is true
a mark left by a foot

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the pulling root, from the family with -ing, -er, and -able, and from the collocations.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「拉」这个词根、由 -ing、-er、-able 构成的词族以及常用搭配入手。

normal.en: Trahere is to pull, so a trace is something drawn out along a line.
normal.cn: trahere 是拉，所以 trace 是沿着一条线拉出来的东西。

normal.en: Trace, tracing, tracer, traceable: noun, act, person, and possibility.
normal.cn: trace、tracing、tracer、traceable，分别是名词、行为、人、可能性。

normal.en: Trace back to is the key phrase: follow the line backwards until it starts.
normal.cn: trace back to 是关键搭配：沿着线往回走，直到它的起点。

normal.en: Without a trace means the line has disappeared completely.
normal.cn: without a trace 意味着这条线完全消失了。

normal.en: A trace of salt is a mark of salt left in the water, not the salt itself.
normal.cn: a trace of salt 是水里的盐留下的印记，而不是盐本身。

abstract.en: Picture a finger drawing a line in dust, then the line slowly being blown away.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指在灰上画出一条线，然后线被慢慢吹散。

abstract.en: Think of a thin thread pulled out of a cloth, going back to the loom.
abstract.cn: 想一根从布里抽出的细线，一路回到织机。

abstract.en: A trace is the past still visible on a surface.
abstract.cn: 痕迹是仍然留在表面上的过去。

examples.en: The police found no trace of the missing boat.
examples.cn: 警方没有找到失踪船只的任何踪迹。

examples.en: The word traces back to an old French verb.
examples.cn: 这个词可以追溯到古法语的一个动词。

examples.en: There was a trace of anger in her voice.
examples.cn: 她的声音里有一丝怒意。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳一斯」——在泥里戳一下，留下一条印子，就是痕迹。

root: 拉丁语 trahere（拉、拖）→ 分词 tractus（拉出的线）→ 古法语 tracier（画线）→ 中古英语 trace。同源词有 track、tract、extract、attract、contract。

sensesIntro.en: From the drawn line the entry spreads in two directions: backwards into the mark left behind and the tiny remains it implies, and forwards into drawing copies and following paths to an origin.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「画出的线」出发，本词向两个方向展开：向内是留下的印记以及由此而来的微量残余，向外是描摹与循路追到源头。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line in the dust showing where something passed.
core.cn: 核心意象：灰土上的一条线，显示出某物经过的路线。

branches.en: The mark itself.
The little that the mark implies.
branches.cn: 印记所暗示的那一点残余。

branches.en: The line drawn by copying.
The line followed along a route.
The line followed back to its start.

intro.en: The word carries the Latin stem tract- pulled into French and English, and its family is formed with -ing, -er, and -able.
intro.cn: 本词带着拉丁词干 tract- 经法语进入英语，其词族由 -ing、-er、-able 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb and its participle are the base of the whole English family, from trace to extract.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁动词及其分词是 trace 到 extract 整个英语词族的基础。

items.example: The stem appears in trace, track, and extract.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干出现在 trace、track、extract 中。

items.example: Transport means to carry across.
Extract means to pull out.
Attract means to pull towards.
Contract means to pull together.
Tracing is the act and its product.
items.exampleCN: tracing 既是行为也是产物。

items.example: A tracer follows a course.
Traceable means it can be followed back.

latinEntries.meaning: drawn; a drawing out, a course

definition_zh: 轨道；足迹；小径；跑道；（作动词）追踪；跟踪；记录
definition_en: a narrow path or railway line, or the marks left by movement, and to follow those marks or keep a record of something
core_image: 两道平行的铁轨在野草之间拐了个弯
scene: 荒废的支线上长满了草，只有两条铁轨还亮着，一直通向远处的山口。The old track runs behind the farm and disappears into the hills.
sceneCN: 这里 track 是「铁轨、轨道」（第 2 个义项：供火车行驶的两条钢轨）；句意为这条旧轨道从农舍后面延伸过去，消失在山间。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成，义为「追踪者；追踪器」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「追踪；定位」
由 track 加 -less 构成，义为「无路的；无足迹的」

senses.title: A narrow path beaten by feet
senses.definition: a rough path in the countryside made by people or animals walking on it
senses.definitionCN: 乡间由人或动物反复行走踩出的小路
senses.example: A narrow track leads from the gate to the orchard.
senses.exampleCN: 一条窄窄的小路从大门通到果园。
senses.why: The word comes from an old verb of drawing or dragging, and a path is literally a line drawn by walking.
senses.whyCN: 本词来自表示拉、拖的古老动词，而小路就是被走线一样「画」出来的。

senses.title: The pair of rails for a train
senses.definition: the steel lines on which a train runs
senses.definitionCN: 供火车行驶的两条钢轨
senses.example: The train slowed as it entered the single track.
senses.exampleCN: 火车进入单线轨道时慢了下来。
senses.why: Rails are the most fixed line of all, so the path sense hardens into the metal route of a railway.
senses.whyCN: 钢轨是最固定的一条线，于是小径之义硬化为铁路的金属路线。

senses.title: Marks left by a moving animal
senses.definition: the prints or signs left by an animal or person walking
senses.definitionCN: 动物或人走动时留下的印迹
senses.example: There were deer tracks in the fresh snow.
senses.exampleCN: 新雪上有鹿的足迹。
senses.why: A path is a line of steps, and the steps themselves leave marks, so both are called by the same word.
senses.whyCN: 小路是一串步子画出的线，而步子本身也留下印记，两者用同一个词表示。

senses.title: To follow a person or animal
senses.definition: to follow the movements of someone or something, often without being seen
senses.definitionCN: 跟随着某人或某物的行动，常常不被察觉
senses.example: They tracked the wolf for two days across the ice.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在冰原上追踪那头狼两天。
senses.why: Reading a line of prints becomes the action of following it, so the noun turns into a verb.
senses.whyCN: 读懂一串脚印，就成了跟着这串脚印走，于是名词转为动词。

senses.title: To keep a record of something
senses.definition: to keep an up-to-date record of how a process, cost, or set of things is changing
senses.definitionCN: 持续记录某个过程、费用或事物集合的变化
senses.example: The app tracks my spending month by month.
senses.exampleCN: 这个应用按月记录我的支出。
senses.why: Keeping track of something is drawing its line as it happens, so recording becomes a kind of tracking.
senses.whyCN: keep track of 就是一边发生一边画出它的线，所以记录也是一种追踪。

senses.title: A prepared course for running
senses.definition: a running course marked out with lanes for sport
senses.definitionCN: 用分道标记出来的体育跑道
senses.example: The runners lined up on the track before the whistle.
senses.exampleCN: 哨响之前，跑者们在跑道上排好了队。
senses.why: A marked line drawn on the ground for a purpose is the most literal reading of the old drawing sense.
senses.whyCN: 为了某个目的在地上画出的标记线，正是古老「画线」语义最字面的读法。

intro.en: Track is borrowed from Old French trac, a trace or a trail, probably Germanic in final origin, and it is related to the Latin pulling root behind trace.
intro.cn: track 借自中古法语 trac（痕迹、行迹），更远来源大概是日耳曼语，并与 trace 背后拉丁语「拉」的词根有关。

items.en: The ultimate origin is probably a Germanic word for a mark drawn or dragged, though the details are debated.
items.cn: 其最终来源大概是日耳曼语中表示「拖出的记号」的词，细节尚有争议。

items.en: Old French trac means a trail, a mark of passage, and also the act of drawing a line.
items.cn: 古法语 trac 意为行迹、经过的记号，也指画线的动作。

items.en: English adopts track in the fifteenth century for a footprint or a path made by walking.
items.cn: 中古英语在十五世纪借入 track，指脚印或走出来的路。

items.en: When railways spread in the nineteenth century, the rails themselves are called the track.
items.cn: 十九世纪铁路普及后，钢轨本身就被称为 track。

items.en: The verb meaning to follow traces is old, but tracking in the modern sense of monitoring a process is recent.
items.cn: 表示跟随痕迹的动词用法很古老，但「监控过程」的现代追踪义是晚近的事。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same drawing and pulling root, while the near-meaning group gathers paths and signs of passage.
note.cn: 形近组收集建立在同一「画线、拉」词根上的词，近义组收集路径与经过的记号。

entries.definition: a mark left by something passing
a person or device that follows movement
an area of land or a system of organs
a path or the marks left on it
entries.definitionCN: 小径；踪迹，拼写相近而来源不同

entries.definition: a way along which people walk
a system of rails for trains
a narrow way or a marked strip of a road

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the drawing root, from the keep-track idioms, and from the picture of rails in grass.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「画线」词根、keep track 一类习语以及草丛里的铁轨画面入手。

normal.en: Track, trace, tract: one pulling root, three shapes of line.
normal.cn: track、trace、tract 共用一个「拉」的词根，是线的三种形态。

normal.en: Keep track of is to hold the line in mind; lose track of is to drop it.
normal.cn: keep track of 是把线记在心里，lose track of 是让线掉了。

normal.en: Track down means to follow the line until the thing is found.
normal.cn: track down 意为顺着线一直追到东西被找到。

normal.en: On track uses the railway image: the train is still on the rails.
normal.cn: on track 用的是铁路意象：火车还在铁轨上。

normal.en: The -er form tracker is both a hunting person and a small electronic device.
normal.cn: -er 形式 tracker 既指猎人，也指小小的电子追踪器。

abstract.en: Picture two bright rails in a field of long grass, going where no road goes.
abstract.cn: 想象长草地里两条发亮的铁轨，通向没有公路的地方。

abstract.en: Think of a strip of fresh snow covered with the prints of one small animal.
abstract.cn: 想新雪上一条印着某只小动物脚印的带状区域。

abstract.en: A track is a decision you can see from outside.
abstract.cn: 轨迹是一个从外面就能看到的决定。

examples.en: We walked along a track between the hedges.
examples.cn: 我们沿着树篱之间的小路走。

examples.en: He tracked the parcel all the way to the door.
examples.cn: 他一直追踪这个包裹直到送上门。

examples.en: Try to keep track of how much you spend each week.
examples.cn: 试着记录你每周花多少钱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳克」——在雪地上戳出一串印子，那就是足迹。

root: 中古法语 trac（行迹、拖出的标记）→ 中古英语 track。与 trace、tract 共享拉丁语 trahere（拉）一系词根；更早的日耳曼来源细节仍有争议。

sensesIntro.en: From a single drawn line, the entry spreads to the path, the rails, the prints, the act of following, the written record, and the marked running course.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条画出的线出发，本词扩展到小路、铁轨、足迹、跟随的动作、书面记录以及划好线的跑道。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line drawn on the ground by something moving along it.
core.cn: 核心意象：某物沿途走过，在地上画出一条线。

branches.en: The soft path worn by feet.
The prepared lines of rail and of race.
The prints the line is made of.
The act of walking the line behind someone.
branches.cn: 跟在别人后面沿线的动作。

branches.en: The note kept of a line as it is drawn.
branches.cn: 一边画线一边做的记录。

intro.en: The word is a French borrowing sharing the Latin stem tract-, and its English family uses -er, -ing, and -less.
intro.cn: 本词是法语借词，与拉丁词干 tract- 共享来源；其英语词族使用 -er、-ing、-less。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pulling verb behind the stem is the ancestor of track, trace, and tract alike.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干背后的拉丁语「拉」的动词，是 track、trace、tract 等词的共同祖先。

items.example: The stem ties track to trace and tract.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干把 track 与 trace、tract 连在一起。

items.example: A tracker follows the line.
Tracking parcels has become routine.
Trackless means without any path.

items.meaning: a steel bar of the track
items.example: Railway is the full system of track.
items.exampleCN: railway 是完整的轨道系统。

items.example: A race track is marked out for running.
items.exampleCN: race track 是为赛跑划出来的跑道。

items.example: A soundtrack follows the film.
Runway and run track share the walking image.
items.exampleCN: runway 与跑道共享「行走」意象。

definition_zh: 拖拉机；牵引车
definition_en: a heavy vehicle with big rear wheels, used on farms to pull ploughs and trailers
core_image: 一台高大的拖拉机拖着犁，在田里翻出一道深沟
scene: 春天的地还硬着，一台高大的车拖着犁从田头开过去，留下整齐的沟。The farmer drove the tractor across the field before the rain came.
sceneCN: 这里 tractor 是「拖拉机」（第 1 个义项：农田上用来牵引农具的重型车辆）；句意为农夫在雨来之前把拖拉机开过了田。

derivatives.zh: 由同一拉丁词干加 -tion 构成，义为「牵引；牵引力」
由词干加 -ive 构成，义为「牵引的」
与 tractor 同源，义为「一片土地；管道」

senses.title: The farm machine that pulls
senses.definition: a powerful farm vehicle with large wheels, used to pull ploughs and heavy loads
senses.definitionCN: 装有巨大车轮、用来拖犁和重物的农用动力车
senses.example: One tractor can plough the whole field in an afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 一台拖拉机一个下午就能把整块地犁完。
senses.why: The word is literally the puller, and on a farm the machine that pulls is this one.
senses.whyCN: 这个词字面意思就是「拉的车」，而在农场上负责拉的就是它。

senses.title: A vehicle for towing on the road
senses.definition: a short powerful motor vehicle used to haul a trailer or a broken-down lorry
senses.definitionCN: 用来拖挂车或拖走抛锚货车的短小动力车
senses.example: A tractor arrived to pull the lorry off the verge.
senses.exampleCN: 一辆牵引车开来把货车从路边拖走了。
senses.why: The same pulling job is done in towns and motorways, so the name follows the function off the farm.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「拉」的任务在城镇与公路上也在执行，于是这个名字跟着功能离开了农田。

senses.title: A blade worked by a motor
senses.definition: in the phrase lawn tractor, a riding mower that pulls itself over the grass
senses.definitionCN: lawn tractor 一类说法中，自行在草地上牵引前进的乘骑式割草机
senses.example: He cut the whole lawn with a small garden tractor.
senses.exampleCN: 他用一台小型园用牵引机割完了整片草坪。
senses.why: Any motor-driven tool that drags itself forward inherits the name because the pulling idea is still visible.
senses.whyCN: 任何靠马达拖着自己前进的工具都能继承这个名字，因为「拉」的意象仍然可见。

intro.en: Tractor is a coined Latin word, from trahere, to pull, with the agent ending -or, and it was applied to motor vehicles in the late nineteenth century.
intro.cn: tractor 是仿拉丁语构词法造的，由 trahere（拉）加施动后缀 -or 构成，十九世纪末被用来指机动车辆。

items.en: Trahere means to pull, draw, or drag, and its stem tract- underlies a large family in English.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、拖，其词干 tract- 在英语中撑起了一个大家族。

items.en: The Latin agent form tractor, meaning a puller, appears in English in the seventeenth century as a term of logic and medicine.
items.cn: 拉丁语施动形式 tractor 意为「拉的东西」，十七世纪在英语中作为逻辑学与医学术语出现。

items.en: In the 1890s the word is taken up for the new steam and petrol engines designed to pull ploughs.
items.cn: 十九世纪九十年代，这个词被用来指新出现的、专为拖犁设计的蒸汽与汽油发动机。

items.en: Twentieth-century mass farming makes the tractor a standard word, and the shortened slang tractor follows.
items.cn: 二十世纪的大规模农业让拖拉机成为常用词，其简称 tractor 也随之固定。

items.en: The idea widens again to road towing vehicles and to riding mowers in the later twentieth century.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期，这一概念再次扩展到公路牵引车与乘骑式割草机。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words with the same Latin pulling stem, and the near-meaning group gathers farm and hauling machines.
note.cn: 形近组收集同用拉丁语「拉」词干的词，近义组收集农用与拖运的机械。

entries.definition: the power of pulling, or grip on the ground
a large area of land
to pull towards
an imaginary pulling ray in science fiction
a farm tool that turns the soil
a machine that cuts and gathers crops
a heavy machine that pushes earth

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the Latin pulling stem, from the -or ending that marks the doer, and from the farm picture.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从拉丁语「拉」的词干、表示施动者的 -or 词尾以及农田画面入手。

normal.en: Trahere is to pull, and -or marks the one that pulls, so tractor is simply the puller.
normal.cn: trahere 是拉，-or 标记拉的那个，所以 tractor 就是「拉着的东西」。

normal.en: Tract, traction, tractor: land pulled together, grip pulled, and the machine that pulls.
normal.cn: tract、traction、tractor 分别是「拉成的土地」「拉的抓力」与「拉的车」。

normal.en: Attract, extract, contract: the same stem with a- for towards, ex- for out, con- for together.
normal.cn: attract、extract、contract 用同一词干，配 a- 表示朝向、ex- 表示向外、con- 表示一起。

normal.en: A tractor is recognised by big back wheels, because those wheels must grip while pulling.
normal.cn: 拖拉机的标志是后轮特别大，因为拖东西时轮子必须抓住地面。

normal.en: Traction is the property, tractor is the user of that property.
normal.cn: traction 是那种性质，tractor 是使用那种性质的机器。

abstract.en: Picture one small engine moving an entire field of heavy soil behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一台小引擎把一整块沉重的土地拖在身后。

abstract.en: Think of a dog pulling a sled, then make the dog iron and the sled a plough.
abstract.cn: 想一只狗拉着雪橇，再把狗换成铁、雪橇换成犁。

abstract.en: A tractor is strength that only knows one direction: forward.
abstract.cn: 拖拉机是一种只知道一个方向的力气：向前。

examples.en: The tractor was parked behind the barn.
examples.cn: 拖拉机停在谷仓后面。

examples.en: Without a tractor the farmers would need many more hands.
examples.cn: 没有拖拉机，农夫们就需要多得多的人手。

examples.en: He learned to drive a tractor at the age of twelve.
examples.cn: 他十二岁就学会了开拖拉机。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拽克特」——专门拽着东西往前走的那个特家伙，就是拖拉机。

root: 拉丁语 trahere（拉、拖）→ 词干 tract- + 施动后缀 -or → 拉丁形容词式 tractor（拉的东西）→ 近代英语 tractor（牵引机、拖拉机）。同族词有 traction、tract、attract、extract、contract。

sensesIntro.en: The whole entry rests on one job, pulling: the farm machine, the road tow truck, and the motor mower that drags itself forward are all names of the puller.
sensesIntro.cn: 整条词义都建立在一件事上，那就是「拉」：农田里的机器、公路上的牵引车，以及自己拖着走的割草机，都是「拉者」的称呼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an engine with huge rear wheels dragging a plough.
core.cn: 核心意象：后轮巨大的引擎拖着犁前行。

branches.en: The machine that pulls farm tools.
The machine that pulls trailers on roads.
branches.cn: 在公路上拖挂车的机器。

branches.en: The small motor that drags itself over grass.
branches.cn: 拖着自己在草地上走的小马达。

branches.en: The core pulling image restated.
The same power moved off the farm.
branches.cn: 同一种动力离开了农田。

intro.en: Tractor is built on the Latin stem tract- plus the agent suffix -or, and its family spreads across prefixes such as at-, ex-, con-, de-, and sub-.
intro.cn: tractor 由拉丁词干 tract- 加施动后缀 -or 构成，其词族散布在 at-、ex-、con-、de-、sub- 等前缀上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb and its participle are the source of every English word given below.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁动词及其分词是以下所有英语词的来源。

items.example: The stem is shared by tractor and traction.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干被 tractor 与 traction 共享。

items.example: Tractor is the thing that pulls.
Traction is the act of pulling.
Tractive force pulls the load.
Attract means to pull towards.
Extract means to pull out.
Detract means to pull value away.
Subtract means to pull away from below the total.
items.exampleCN: subtract 意为从总数中扣减。

items.example: A tractable load can be pulled along.
items.exampleCN: tractable 的负载是可以被拉动的。

definition_zh: 贸易；交易；行业；手艺；（作动词）交易；从事贸易
definition_en: the activity of buying and selling goods, or a kind of work that needs skill, and to buy and sell or exchange
core_image: 集市上两只手把货物和钱交换过来
scene: 码头边的集市一早开市，盐、布和铁器在不同的摊位上被换来换去。The two ports have traded salt and timber for three hundred years.
sceneCN: 这里 trade 是「贸易」（第 1 个义项：买进卖出的商业活动）；句意为这两个港口三百年来一直进行盐与木材的贸易。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成，义为「商人；交易者」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「交易；买卖」
由 trade 加 mark 合成，义为「商标」

senses.title: The buying and selling of goods
senses.definition: the business of exchanging goods or services between people, companies, or countries
senses.definitionCN: 个人、公司或国家之间交换货物或服务的活动
senses.example: Trade between the two islands stopped during the storm season.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴季期间两座岛之间的贸易中断了。
senses.why: The word first named a track or a beaten path, and trade was the traffic that moved along those paths.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指一条被踩出来的路线，而贸易正是沿着这些路线流动的往来。

senses.title: A skilled occupation
senses.definition: a kind of work, usually one needing training with the hands, such as carpentry
senses.definitionCN: 一种通常需要手上训练的工作，如木工
senses.example: His trade was that of a wheelwright.
senses.exampleCN: 他的本行是造车轮。
senses.why: Crafts were once practised along particular streets, so the way of making a living took the name of the path.
senses.whyCN: 手艺活儿曾集中在特定街道上经营，于是谋生的方式也沿用了「路」这个名称。

senses.title: A particular branch of business
senses.definition: all the businesses that deal in one kind of goods or service, taken together
senses.definitionCN: 经营同一类商品或服务的所有商家的总称
senses.example: The book trade fears the new tax on paper.
senses.exampleCN: 图书业界担心新的纸张税。
senses.why: When many people share one occupation, the occupation itself becomes a collective body with its own interests.
senses.whyCN: 当许多人从事同一行，这门职业本身就成了有自身利益的集体。

senses.title: To exchange one thing for another
senses.definition: to give something to someone and receive something else in return
senses.definitionCN: 把某物给某人，同时换回另一样东西
senses.example: The boys traded marbles for a football card.
senses.exampleCN: 男孩们用弹珠换了一张足球卡。
senses.why: Any buying and selling is at bottom an exchange, so the noun turns into a simple verb of swapping.
senses.whyCN: 买卖归根到底就是交换，于是名词变成简单的「互换」动词。

senses.title: To deal in goods professionally
senses.definition: to run a business that buys and sells a stated kind of goods
senses.definitionCN: 经营买卖某类特定商品的生意
senses.example: The firm trades in coffee and cocoa.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司经营咖啡与可可。
senses.why: The verb with in marks the goods that the business lives by, as opposed to goods swapped in passing.
senses.whyCN: 动词后加 in 标记这家生意赖以生存的商品，与随手换东西不同。

senses.title: Swapping one problem for another
senses.definition: in phrases like trade places, to exchange positions or situations with someone
senses.definitionCN: 如 trade places 一类说法中，与某人交换位置或处境
senses.example: For a day the two managers traded places to see the work from below.
senses.exampleCN: 两位经理交换了一天位置，从下面看看这份工作。
senses.why: Once the verb means swap, it can swap anything, including roles that are not goods at all.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个动词表示互换，它就可以换任何东西，包括根本不是商品的角色。

intro.en: Trade comes from Middle Low German trade, a track or course, and the sense of commerce grew in English from traffic moving along such paths.
intro.cn: trade 来自中古低地德语 trade（路线、轨道），「商业」这一含义是在英语中由沿这些路线往来的货运生长出来的。

items.en: Middle Low German trade means a track, a course, or a beaten way.
items.cn: 中古低地德语 trade 意为路径、走向或踩出来的道。

items.en: English borrows the word in the fourteenth century with the sense of a regular course or way of life.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入这个词，意为惯常的路线或生活方式。

items.en: From the course of travelling merchants come the senses of traffic, commerce, and finally buying and selling between nations.
items.cn: 从商人往来的路线，发展出货运、商业，最后是国与国之间的买卖。

items.en: In the sixteenth century trade also settles into the sense of a skilled craft or occupation.
items.cn: 十六世纪，trade 又固定为指一门需要技艺的行当或职业。

items.en: The verb and phrases such as trade union spread in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries with industrial growth.
items.cn: 动词用法以及 trade union 一类说法随着工业成长在十八、十九世纪流行开来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same trade stem, and the near-meaning group gathers commercial terms.
note.cn: 形近组收集建立在同一 trade 词干上的词，近义组收集商业术语。

entries.definition: a person who buys and sells
the activity of buying and selling
a registered sign of a business
to walk or step
entries.definitionCN: 踩；踏，拼写相近而来源不同

entries.definition: large-scale trade between businesses
the work of making and selling things
a job that needs training and skill

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the original sense of a path, from the compounds, and from the verb patterns with in and for.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「路径」这一原义、复合词以及动词后接 in、for 的模式入手。

normal.en: Trade began as a track, so trade is the traffic on that track.
normal.cn: trade 原是「路线」，所以贸易就是这条路线上的人流物流。

normal.en: Trade in coffee means dealing in coffee; trade with a country means doing business with it.
normal.cn: trade in coffee 是经营咖啡，trade with a country 是与某国做生意。

normal.en: Trade union, trade fair, trade mark: in front of a noun the word means belonging to business.
normal.cn: trade union、trade fair、trade mark，放在名词前就表示「属于商业的」。

normal.en: By trade means by occupation, showing the old craft sense.
normal.cn: by trade 意为「就职业而言」，显示古老的「手艺」义项。

normal.en: Trader and trading split the verb into a person and an activity.
normal.cn: trader 与 trading 把这个动词分成人和活动两面。

abstract.en: Picture two hands meeting over a table, one holding a sack, the other coins.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在桌上相握，一只握着袋子，一只握着硬币。

abstract.en: Think of a road that gets deeper as more carts use it, and the carts are the trade.
abstract.cn: 想一条路越被车轧越深，而那些车就是贸易。

abstract.en: Trade is trust that has been made repeatable.
abstract.cn: 贸易是被做成可重复的信任。

examples.en: The town grew rich on the wool trade.
examples.cn: 这个镇靠羊毛贸易富了起来。

examples.en: By trade he was a carpenter, but he spent his nights writing.
examples.cn: 他本行是木匠，却把夜晚都用来写作。

examples.en: The two children traded hats and laughed.
examples.cn: 两个孩子换着帽子，笑了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹得」——生意吹得再大，也是一手交钱一手交货。

root: 中古低地德语 trade（路线、轨道）→ 中古英语 trade（常走的路、生活方式）→ 现代英语 trade（贸易；行业）。词族有 trader、trading、trademark。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts from a path, turns it into the commerce that travels it, then into the skilled calling practised on it, then into the whole industry, and ends with the verb of swapping anything at all.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从小路出发，转成沿着它流动的商业，再成为路上经营的行当与整个业界，最后落在一换一切东西的动词上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: goods and money passing between two hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：货物与钱在两只手之间交换。

branches.en: The commerce that moves along the routes.
The skilled work of a person.
branches.cn: 一个人熟练的谋生手艺。

branches.en: The whole body of that business.
The plain act of swapping, including roles.
branches.cn: 纯粹互换的动作，包括角色。

branches.en: The professional dealing in stated goods.

intro.en: The word is a Low German borrowing with no productive suffix, and its family is built with -er, -ing, and compounds such as mark.
intro.cn: 本词是低地德语借词，没有能产后缀，其词族由 -er、-ing 以及 mark 一类复合成分构成。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin source, so no Latin entries are listed; the nearest Latin vocabulary is commercial rather than etymological.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁词条；拉丁语中最近的词汇只是意义上的商务用语，并非同源。

items.example: Trade shifted from a path to commerce.
A trader buys and sells.
Trading runs all day on the floor.
items.exampleCN: 交易大厅里全天都在交易。
