items.example: Trades is both plural and verb form.
items.exampleCN: trades 既是复数也是动词形式。

items.example: A trademark marks a business.
A trade union protects skilled workers.
A trade fair shows new goods.
items.exampleCN: 贸易博览会展示新商品。

items.example: Free trade means open buying and selling.
items.exampleCN: 自由贸易就是开放的买卖。

definition_zh: 传统；惯例；习俗；传承
definition_en: a belief, custom, or way of doing something that has been passed down from one generation to the next
core_image: 一只手把一件老器物递给下一代的手
scene: 除夕夜老人把祖传的木勺交给孩子，让他搅第一下锅里的汤。The family keeps the tradition of cooking the same soup every winter night.
sceneCN: 这里 tradition 是「传统」（第 1 个义项：世代相传的习俗或做法）；句意为这家人保留着每个冬夜煮同样一锅汤的传统。

derivatives.zh: 由名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「传统的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「按照传统地」
由形容词加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义」

senses.title: A custom handed down through generations
senses.definition: a habit or belief that has been passed from older people to younger ones over many years
senses.definitionCN: 由年长者传给年轻一代、延续多年的习惯或信念
senses.example: The tradition of singing at harvest has lasted four centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 丰收时节唱歌的传统已延续了四百年。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to hand over, so a tradition is literally a thing handed from hand to hand.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「交出、交付」，所以传统就是一手一手传下来的东西。

senses.title: The body of such customs as a whole
senses.definition: all the customs and beliefs of a people or group considered together
senses.definitionCN: 一个民族或群体的全部习俗与信念的总和
senses.example: He knows the oral tradition of the mountain villages well.
senses.exampleCN: 他对山村的民间传统非常熟悉。
senses.why: Many handings-down pile up into a store, and that store is called the tradition of a people.
senses.whyCN: 许多次传递堆成一个库，这个库就被称为一个民族的传统。

senses.title: A way of working in an art or craft
senses.definition: an established style or method passed on within an art, science, or craft
senses.definitionCN: 在某门艺术、学问或手艺内部沿袭下来的既定风格或方法
senses.example: The painter works in the tradition of the northern landscape schools.
senses.exampleCN: 这位画家属于北方山水流派一脉。
senses.why: Skills are handed down like objects, so a school of art becomes a tradition carried by masters and pupils.
senses.whyCN: 技艺像器物一样被递下去，于是一个艺术流派就成了由师承承担的传统。

senses.title: The act of handing something over
senses.definition: the formal act of passing something into another person's keeping
senses.definitionCN: 把某物正式交到他人手里的行为
senses.example: The tradition of the keys to the new mayor takes place at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 把钥匙交给新市长的仪式在正午举行。
senses.why: This is the oldest legal sense, still visible in the English verb hand over.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的法律含义，在英语 hand over 这一说法里仍能看见。

senses.title: A long-held custom in an institution
senses.definition: an established practice in a school, office, or team that everyone follows
senses.definitionCN: 学校、机关或团队里人人遵循的既定做法
senses.example: It is a tradition here that the newest member makes the tea.
senses.exampleCN: 这里有个惯例：最新来的成员负责泡茶。
senses.why: Small groups create their own handings-down, and the word serves for these everyday customs too.
senses.whyCN: 小群体也会形成自己的传递，这个词同样用于这些日常惯例。

intro.en: Tradition comes from Latin traditio, a handing over, from tradere, to hand across, made of trans-, across, and dare, to give.
intro.cn: tradition 来自拉丁语 traditio（交付），源自 tradere（交过去），由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）构成。

items.en: Tradere is built from trans-, across, and dare, to give, and means to hand over or deliver.
items.cn: tradere 由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）合成，意为交出、交付。

items.en: Traditio names the act of delivery and, in law, the transfer of property into another's hands.
items.cn: traditio 指交付行为，在法律上指把财产转移到他方手中。

items.en: Old French tradition keeps the sense of handing down teaching and custom.
items.cn: 古法语 tradition 保留了传授教义与习俗的含义。

items.en: English uses tradition first in religious writing for teaching received from the fathers of the church.
items.cn: 英语最先在宗教文献中使用 tradition，指从教父那里接受的教导。

items.en: From the seventeenth century the word widens to any custom or practice inherited from the past.
items.cn: 十七世纪起，这个词扩展到任何从过去继承下来的习俗或做法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same giving stem, while the near-meaning group gathers customs and inherited practice.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一「给」词根的词，近义组收集习俗与沿袭的做法。

entries.definition: following old customs
in the old customary way
one who hands over his own side
to hand someone over to an enemy
a usual way of behaving in a group
the things and ways inherited from the past
an accepted way of doing things

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the giving root, from the family of -al, -ly, and -ism, and from the picture of a handover.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「给」的词根、由 -al、-ly、-ism 构成的词族以及「递交」的画面入手。

normal.en: Trans- plus dare: give across. A tradition is what gets given across the years.
normal.cn: trans- 加 dare，就是「给过去」。传统就是被给过岁月的那些东西。

normal.en: The same root gives traitor and betray, because to hand someone over is also to betray.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 traitor 与 betray，因为把人交出去也就是出卖。

normal.en: Traditional adds -al, traditionally adds -ly, traditionalism adds -ism.
normal.cn: traditional 加 -al，traditionally 加 -ly，traditionalism 加 -ism。

normal.en: Break with tradition and keep the tradition are opposites in one phrase family.
normal.cn: break with tradition 与 keep the tradition 是同一搭配族里的对立面。

normal.en: The word ends in -tion, so it names the thing and the act of handing down at once.
normal.cn: 本词以 -tion 结尾，同时指被传下来的东西与传递这一行为。

abstract.en: Picture an old wooden spoon passed from a grandmother's hand to a grandchild's.
abstract.cn: 想象一把旧木勺从祖母的手递到孙辈的手里。

abstract.en: Think of a path worn by many feet over centuries, still visible under fresh grass.
abstract.cn: 想一条被几百年脚步踩出的路，如今仍在新草下隐约可见。

abstract.en: A tradition is a choice that has already been made many times before you make it.
abstract.cn: 传统是一个在你做出之前就已经被做过许多次的选择。

examples.en: It is a tradition to eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
examples.cn: 除夕吃饺子是一项传统。

examples.en: The village has kept its fishing traditions for many centuries.
examples.cn: 这个村子把捕鱼传统保留了许多个世纪。

examples.en: By tradition the eldest son lights the first lamp.
examples.cn: 按照传统，由长子点亮第一盏灯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿递什」——一代人穿过时间把手里的东西递交给下一代。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ dare（给）→ tradere（交付）→ traditio（交付、传交）→ 古法语 tradition → 英语 tradition。同源词有 traitor、betray、tradition（教义传承义）。

sensesIntro.en: The root means a handover, so the entry begins with the custom handed down, gathers such handovers into a people's whole store, narrows to the school of an art, returns to the bare legal handover, and ends with the small customs of an institution.
sensesIntro.cn: 词根意为「递交」，因此本词先指被递下来的习俗，再把递交聚成一个民族的全部家底，收窄为艺术流派，回到纯粹的法律交付，最后落在团体内部的小惯例。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing passed from an older hand into a younger one.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件东西从年长的手递进年轻的手。

branches.en: The single custom handed down.
All such customs together.
A tradition inside an art or craft.
branches.cn: 艺术或手艺内部的传承体系。

branches.en: The bare act of delivery in law.
branches.cn: 法律上纯粹的交付行为。

branches.en: The small habit of a group.

intro.en: The word rests on the Latin verb dare, to give, with the prefix trans- and the noun ending -tio; English adds -al, -ly, and -ism.
intro.cn: 本词建立在拉丁语动词 dare（给）之上，配前缀 trans- 与名词词尾 -tio；英语再加 -al、-ly、-ism。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries below show the giving verb and the handing-over noun behind this word.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁词条给出本词背后的「给」动词与「交付」名词。

items.example: Dare is the core verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: dare 是这个词族的核心动词。

items.example: Trans- turns giving into giving across.
Tradition is the handing down and what is handed down.
items.exampleCN: tradition 既是传递行为也是传递之物。

items.example: Traditional means relating to tradition.
items.exampleCN: traditional 意为与传统相关的。

items.example: Traditionally adds the adverb ending.
Traditionalism values the old ways.
A traditionalist follows old customs.
Traitor keeps the older sense of handing over.
items.exampleCN: traitor 保留了「交出」的旧义。

definition_zh: 传统的；惯例的；因袭的
definition_en: following or belonging to the customs and beliefs that have been handed down over a long time
core_image: 一件按老样子做成的家具，榫卯没上一颗钉子
scene: 木匠铺里那张老式方桌不用一颗钉子，全靠榫头咬合，看的人都说是老样子。Her wedding dress was traditional, with hand embroidery at the collar.
sceneCN: 这里 traditional 是「传统的」（第 1 个义项：遵循长期沿袭下来的样式或做法）；句意为她的婚纱是传统样式，领口有手工刺绣。

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀 -al 得到名词，义为「传统」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「按照传统地」
由形容词加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义」

senses.title: Following old customs
senses.definition: made or done according to the customs and styles of the past
senses.definitionCN: 按照过去的习俗与样式制作或执行
senses.example: They served a traditional dish of rice and salted fish.
senses.exampleCN: 他们上了一道米饭配咸鱼的传统菜。
senses.why: The adjective simply says that a thing belongs to what has been handed down.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只是说某物属于那些被传下来的东西。

senses.title: Belonging to an older system of ideas
senses.definition: belonging to an older way of thinking and often opposed to newer ideas
senses.definitionCN: 属于较旧的思维方式，常与较新的观念相对
senses.example: He holds fairly traditional views on family life.
senses.exampleCN: 他对家庭生活的看法相当传统。
senses.why: What is handed down can be a belief rather than an object, so the adjective also describes attitudes.
senses.whyCN: 被传下来的可以是信念而非器物，因此这个形容词也能描写态度。

senses.title: Established by long practice in a field
senses.definition: describing the standard method used for a long time in an art, craft, or industry
senses.definitionCN: 指某项艺术、工艺或行业中长期使用的标准方法
senses.example: The traditional method of dyeing uses indigo leaves.
senses.exampleCN: 传统的染色方法使用蓝草叶。
senses.why: Method is passed from master to pupil, so the usual technique of a trade counts as traditional.
senses.whyCN: 方法是师徒相传的，所以一门行当的常用技法就被视为传统的。

senses.title: Of the old style rather than the new
senses.definition: built or designed in a way that imitates older forms, often as a positive value
senses.definitionCN: 以模仿较古老形式的方式建造或设计的，常含褒义
senses.example: The new library has a traditional stone front but a glass hall.
senses.exampleCN: 新图书馆有着传统的石砌立面，里面却是玻璃大厅。
senses.why: Architecture borrows the label to say it keeps the old shape while using new materials.
senses.whyCN: 建筑借用这个标签，表示它保留旧形态却使用新材料。

senses.title: Using the older classified method
senses.definition: in grammar and teaching, describing methods that keep the older ordered forms
senses.definitionCN: 在语法与教学中，指保留旧有程式的方法
senses.example: Traditional grammar lists the eight parts of speech.
senses.exampleCN: 传统语法列出八种词类。
senses.why: Every discipline keeps a set of inherited terms, and those are labelled traditional to mark them off from new ones.
senses.whyCN: 每门学问都保存着一套继承下来的术语，用 traditional 来标记它们以区别于新术语。

intro.en: Traditional is a later English formation from tradition, which came from Latin traditio, a delivering over, with the adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: traditional 是英语后来由 tradition 加形容词后缀 -al 构成；tradition 源自拉丁语 traditio（交付）。

items.en: Traditio means a handing over or delivery, and traditionalis appears in late Latin for what is handed down.
items.cn: traditio 意为交付、递交，晚期拉丁语中已有 traditionalis 表示「被传下来的」。

items.en: French tradition carries the noun into learned use, and its adjective traditionel follows.
items.cn: 法语 tradition 把这个名词带进书面语，其形容词 traditionel 也随之出现。

items.en: English forms traditional in the sixteenth century, at first for teaching received from authority.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪构成 traditional，起初指从权威那里领受的教导。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the word is applied to styles of art and building that imitate older forms.
items.cn: 十九世纪，这个词被用来指模仿较早形式的艺术与建筑风格。

items.en: The comparative more traditional and the phrase traditional values become common in ordinary speech in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 比较级 more traditional 与传统一说传统的价值在二十世纪成为日常说法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the word family built with -al, -ly, and -ism, while the near-meaning group gathers words for old and inherited ways.
note.cn: 形近组收集由 -al、-ly、-ism 构成的词族，近义组收集表示古老与承袭的词。

in the customary way
valuing old ways of doing things
relating to a change from one state to another
entries.definitionCN: 过渡的，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: following what is generally accepted

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the -al suffix, from the compound habits of the word, and from the picture of nail-free joinery.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从 -al 后缀、本词的复合搭配以及不用钉子的榫接画面入手。

normal.en: Tradition plus -al: the suffix turns the custom into a description.
normal.cn: tradition 加 -al，后缀把习俗变成一种描述。

normal.en: Traditional method, traditional culture, traditional values: three very common partners.
normal.cn: traditional method、traditional culture、traditional values，三个最常见的搭档。

normal.en: Words ending in -al take more and most, not -er and -est.
normal.cn: 以 -al 结尾的词用 more 与 most，不用 -er 与 -est。

normal.en: Traditional is neutral; old-fashioned often carries a hint of blame.
normal.cn: traditional 是中性的，old-fashioned 常含一点批评。

normal.en: A traditional building copies the shape of older ones even when the materials are new.
normal.cn: 传统建筑即便用新材料，也照抄了更早建筑的外形。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden table held together without a single nail, only by cut joints.
abstract.cn: 想象一张木桌一颗钉子也没用，全靠凿出的榫卯扣住。

abstract.en: Think of a recipe written in a grandmother's hand and never changed.
abstract.cn: 想一份祖母手写、从未改过的菜谱。

abstract.en: Traditional is what time has tested and left standing.
abstract.cn: 传统就是被时间检验过、仍然立着的东西。

examples.en: They cooked the meal in the traditional way, over a wood fire.
examples.cn: 他们用传统方式做饭，在柴火上煮。

examples.en: Traditional medicine is still widely used in the countryside.
examples.cn: 传统医学在乡间仍然广泛使用。

examples.en: Her family is more traditional than mine.
examples.cn: 她的家庭比我家更传统。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿递神呢」——一代代穿递下来的神气东西，就叫传统式的。

root: 拉丁语 tradere（交付）→ traditio（交付、传承）→ 英语 tradition + 形容词后缀 -al → traditional。词族另有 -ly、-ism、-ist 等形式。

sensesIntro.en: The adjective begins with objects made by old custom, moves to beliefs, then to the established method of a craft, then to imitated older styles, and finally to inherited terms in a discipline.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个形容词先指按旧俗做成的事物，转到信念，再到一门手艺的既定方法，再到被模仿的旧风格，最后指一门学问里被继承的术语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing made the old way, without any new part.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件按老办法做成、没有任何新部件的东西。

branches.en: Things made by old custom.
Beliefs carried from the older system.
The standard technique of a trade.
Older shapes imitated in new building.
branches.cn: 新建筑中模仿的旧形态。

branches.en: The inherited terms of a discipline.
branches.cn: 一门学问继承下来的术语。

intro.en: Traditional is tradition plus the Latin adjective suffix -al, and its family uses -ly, -ism, and -ist.
intro.cn: traditional 是 tradition 加拉丁形容词后缀 -al，其词族使用 -ly、-ism、-ist。

latinIntro.en: The Latin giving verb behind the noun is shown below with the handover noun and the adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 下面列出名词背后的拉丁语「给」动词，以及表示交付的名词与形容词。

items.example: Dare sits at the root of the noun.
items.exampleCN: dare 位于这个名词的词根处。

items.example: The prefix makes giving into handing over.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「给」变成「交过去」。

items.example: Tradition is the handing down itself.
Traditional means relating to tradition.
Traditionally is the adverb form.
Traditionalism defends old customs.
A traditionalist prefers the old way.
Traditionalness is rare in speech but regular in form.
items.exampleCN: traditionalness 口语少用，但构词规则。

definition_zh: 按照传统地；传统上；一贯地
definition_en: in the way that has been usual and handed down over a long time
core_image: 一条被无数人走惯的老路，脚步自然就顺着它拐弯
scene: 每年秋收，村里人还是先祭再开镰，谁也说不清为什么，反正一直这么做。Traditionally the harvest begins with a short ceremony in the field.
sceneCN: 这里 traditionally 是「按照传统地」（第 1 个义项：以长期沿袭的方式）；句意为按传统，收割前要先在田里举行一个简短的仪式。

pos.zh: 副词：按照传统地；传统上

derivatives.zh: 去掉 -ly 得到形容词，义为「传统的」
去掉 -al 与 -ly 得到名词，义为「传统」
由形容词加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义」

senses.title: In the old customary manner
senses.definition: in the way that people have done a thing for a long time
senses.definitionCN: 以人们长久以来做某事的方式
senses.example: The bread is traditionally baked in a stone oven.
senses.exampleCN: 这种面包传统上是在石炉里烘烤的。
senses.why: The adverb simply reports that the action follows an inherited way, and this is its central use.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词只是说明该动作遵循沿袭的方式，这是它最核心的用法。

senses.title: As was long accepted to be so
senses.definition: used to state what has long been believed or assumed, often before a correction
senses.definitionCN: 用于陈述长久以来的看法或假定，后面常跟一个纠正
senses.example: Traditionally, the work was thought to be men's work.
senses.exampleCN: 传统上，这项工作被认为是男人的活。
senses.why: Attitudes are inherited as well as actions, so the adverb also frames an old belief as an old belief.
senses.whyCN: 被传下来的除了做法还有看法，所以这个副词也用来把一种旧看法框定为「旧看法」。

senses.title: In the usual or expected place
senses.definition: in the position or role that has become the pattern, especially in a family or team
senses.definitionCN: 在已成定式的位置或角色上，尤指家庭或团队中
senses.example: Traditionally, the youngest child sits nearest the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 按惯例，最小的孩子坐在离火最近的地方。
senses.why: Small pattern-making habits repeat until they become the expected arrangement, and the adverb marks them as such.
senses.whyCN: 小习惯不断重复，直到成为众人预期的安排，副词就标记这种安排。

senses.title: By the older method rather than the new
senses.definition: used before a participle to say that something is done with the older, non-modern technique
senses.definitionCN: 用在分词前，表示采用较古老而非现代的技术来做
senses.example: The cheese is traditionally made with raw milk.
senses.exampleCN: 这种奶酪传统上用生奶制作。
senses.why: When two methods exist, the older one needs a label, and this adverb supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 当两种方法并存，较旧的那一种需要一个标签，而这个副词正好提供它。

senses.title: According to long-standing practice in a field
senses.definition: used to describe what a subject or profession has done by established practice
senses.definitionCN: 用来描述某个学科或行业按既定做法所做的事
senses.example: The subject is traditionally divided into three periods.
senses.exampleCN: 这门学科传统上分为三个时期。
senses.why: Every field carries fixed divisions, so the adverb marks what the old division has always been.
senses.whyCN: 每门学科都带着固定的划分，副词就标记这种旧划分一直是怎样。

intro.en: Traditionally is tradition with the adjective ending -al and the adverb ending -ly, whose root is Latin tradere, to hand over.
intro.cn: traditionally 是 tradition 加形容词词尾 -al 与副词词尾 -ly，其词根是拉丁语 tradere（交付）。

items.en: Traditio is a delivery or handover, built from trans-, across, and dare, to give.
items.cn: traditio 意为交付、递交，由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）构成。

items.en: Tradition enters English through Old French, and the adjective traditional is formed in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: tradition 经古法语进入英语，形容词 traditional 在十六世纪形成。

items.en: The adverb ending -ly is added to many such adjectives in the seventeenth century, giving traditionally.
items.cn: 十七世纪，许多同类形容词加上副词词尾 -ly，traditionally 由此成形。

items.en: The adverb becomes frequent in writing about food, farming, and institutions from the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪起，这个副词在关于饮食、农业与机构的写作中频繁出现。

items.en: In modern usage it often frames a claim before the writer disagrees with it.
items.cn: 在现代用法中，它常常出现在作者即将表示异议之前，为旧说法作框。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the -al and -ly chain of the family, while the near-meaning group gathers adverbs for usual and older practice.
note.cn: 形近组顺着这一族 -al 与 -ly 的链条展开，近义组收集表示惯常与较旧做法的副词。

entries.definition: following old custom
a custom handed down
a person who defends old customs
in a way relating to change
entries.definitionCN: 过渡地，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: according to habit or custom
in the accepted way
most of the time

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the -al plus -ly chain, from the passive constructions the adverb prefers, and from the picture of the old path.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从 -al 加 -ly 的链条、这个副词偏爱的被动结构以及老路的画面入手。

normal.en: Tradition, traditional, traditionally: noun, adjective, adverb, one step each.
normal.cn: tradition、traditional、traditionally，名词、形容词、副词，各一步。

normal.en: Traditionally made, traditionally grown, traditionally cooked: the word loves a passive participle.
normal.cn: traditionally made、traditionally grown、traditionally cooked，这个词最爱跟被动分词。

normal.en: Traditionally, the work was thought to be men's work: the adverb sets an old belief up for review.
normal.cn: 这个副词先把「这项工作一向被认为是男人的活」这样的旧看法摆出来等评断。

normal.en: The -ally ending is -al plus -ly, never a single suffix.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ally 是 -al 加 -ly，从来不是一个后缀。

normal.en: If the adverb sits first with a comma, it usually frames a whole old custom.
normal.cn: 若副词位于句首并带逗号，通常是为一整套旧习俗作框。

abstract.en: Picture feet that turn at a certain corner without anyone telling them to.
abstract.cn: 想象一些脚在某个转角自动拐弯，没人指挥。

abstract.en: Think of a recipe that never says why, only how.
abstract.cn: 想一份从不解释为什么、只说怎么做的菜谱。

abstract.en: Traditionally is the voice of the path, not of the planner.
abstract.cn: traditionally 是路径自己的声音，而不是规划者的声音。

examples.en: This cheese is traditionally made in small mountain farms.
examples.cn: 这种奶酪传统上在小山场里制作。

examples.en: Traditionally, the eldest son inherits the house.
examples.cn: 传统上，长子继承这所房子。

examples.en: The festival is traditionally held in early spring.
examples.cn: 这个节日传统上在早春举行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿递神呢里」——在穿递下来的神气东西里面，照老规矩办。

root: 拉丁语 tradere（交付）→ traditio（传承）→ 英语 tradition → traditional（+ -al）→ traditionally（+ -ly）。

sensesIntro.en: The adverb begins as a plain report of doing things the old way, then covers old beliefs, expected arrangements, older techniques, and the fixed divisions of a subject.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个副词起初只是平实报告「照老办法做」，之后涵盖旧看法、预期中的安排、较旧的技术，以及一门学科的固定划分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: steps that follow a path worn by many previous walkers.
core.cn: 核心意象：跟着众多前人踩出的路走的脚步。

branches.en: The plain report of customary action.
branches.cn: 对惯常做法的平实陈述。

branches.en: The framing of an inherited belief.
The expected family or team arrangement.
branches.cn: 家庭或团队中预期的安排。

branches.en: The older technique beside the new one.
branches.cn: 与新技术并存的旧技术。

branches.en: The fixed divisions of a subject.

intro.en: The word stacks the Latin noun ending -tion, the adjective suffix -al, and the English adverb suffix -ly on the giving root.
intro.cn: 本词在「给」的词根上依次叠加拉丁名词词尾 -tion、形容词后缀 -al 与英语副词后缀 -ly。

latinIntro.en: The Latin giving verb and the handover noun behind the whole stack are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 下面列出这一整串叠加背后的拉丁语「给」动词与「交付」名词。

items.example: Dare is the root of the whole chain.
The prefix makes the giving a handover.
Tradition is the act of handing down.
Traditional is the adjective step.
The -ly ending turns the adjective into an adverb.

items.meaningCN: 由 -al 与 -ly 合成的拼写
items.example: The -ally spelling shows two suffixes.
items.exampleCN: 拼写 -ally 显示出两个后缀。

items.example: Traditionalism is the belief, not the manner.
A traditionalist acts from the belief.

definition_zh: 交通；往来车辆；运输量；（非法）交易
definition_en: the vehicles moving along a road, or the movement of goods and people, and also illegal dealing in goods
core_image: 一条被车塞满的路，车灯一盏接一盏亮着
scene: 傍晚的高架桥上，车一辆贴着一辆，红色的尾灯一直排到看不见的地方。We left early to avoid the traffic on the ring road.
sceneCN: 这里 traffic 是「交通、往来车辆」（第 1 个义项：路上行驶的车辆及其流动）；句意为我们早早出发，以避开环路拥堵的车流。

pos.zh: 名词：交通；车流；运输；（非法）交易

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成（双写 k），义为「非法贩运者」
由动词加 -ing 构成（双写 k），义为「非法贩运」

senses.title: Vehicles moving on roads
senses.definition: the cars, buses, and lorries moving along a road at any one time
senses.definitionCN: 某一时刻在道路上行驶的汽车、公交与货车
senses.example: The traffic was so heavy we walked the last mile.
senses.exampleCN: 车流太堵，最后一英里我们是走过去的。
senses.why: The word comes from an Italian verb of trading, and traffic on a road is simply the commerce moving there.
senses.whyCN: 本词来自意大利语「做买卖」的动词，路上的车流就是在这条路上流动的商贸。

senses.title: The movement of goods and people
senses.definition: the movement of people or goods by road, rail, sea, or air
senses.definitionCN: 人或货物通过公路、铁路、海路或航空的流动
senses.example: The port handles freight traffic from three continents.
senses.exampleCN: 这个港口处理来自三大洲的货运。
senses.why: Once the word means movement, it can measure that movement in tonnes and passengers rather than count cars.
senses.whyCN: 一旦本词表示流动，就可以用吨位和客流来度量这种流动，而不只是数车。

senses.title: The number of visitors to a place
senses.definition: the amount of people or data passing through a place or system in a period
senses.definitionCN: 一段时间内通过某地或某系统的客流或数据量
senses.example: The website had record traffic after the article appeared.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇文章出现后，网站访问量创了纪录。
senses.why: A modern network also has traffic, since messages move through it as goods move along roads.
senses.whyCN: 现代网络也有 traffic，因为消息在网络中的流动正如货物在路上的流动。

senses.title: Illegal dealing in goods
senses.definition: the buying and selling of something illegal, such as drugs or stolen goods
senses.definitionCN: 买卖毒品、赃物等违法物品
senses.example: The police broke up a traffic in stolen bicycles.
senses.exampleCN: 警方打掉了一桩被盗自行车的交易。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: trade itself, which turns dark when the goods are forbidden.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的含义：贸易本身，当货物被禁时就变成了黑色交易。

senses.title: To deal illegally
senses.definition: to buy and sell something illegal, used mostly in the form trafficking
senses.definitionCN: 买卖违法物品，多见于 trafficking 这一形式
senses.example: They were charged with trafficking in protected birds.
senses.exampleCN: 他们被控非法买卖受保护的鸟类。
senses.why: The verb keeps only the unlawful branch of the old trade meaning, so it almost always names a crime.
senses.whyCN: 动词只保留了旧「贸易」义中不合法的那一支，因此几乎总指犯罪。

intro.en: Traffic comes from Italian traffico, trade, probably from trafficare, to trade, with a possible ultimate link to a word for grinding or moving about.
intro.cn: traffic 来自意大利语 traffico（贸易），大概出自 trafficare（做买卖），其更远来源可能与表示「碾磨、往来」的词有关。

items.en: The deeper source is disputed; some trace it to a Vulgar Latin verb of moving goods about, others to an Arabic root.
items.cn: 更深来源有争议，有人追溯到通俗拉丁语表示搬运货物的动词，也有人主张来自阿拉伯语词根。

items.en: Italian traffico means commerce or trade, often with a hint of dealings that are not quite clean.
items.cn: 意大利语 traffico 意为商业、贸易，常带着「不太干净的买卖」的暗示。

items.en: French trafic carries the word into wider use in the sixteenth century, still meaning trade.
items.cn: 十六世纪法语 trafic 把这个词带进更广的使用，仍指贸易。

items.en: English adopts traffic for trade, and the phrase traffic in goods becomes common.
items.cn: 英语借入 traffic 表示贸易，traffic in goods 一类说法变得常见。

items.en: In the nineteenth century, with railways and busy streets, the word shifts to the movement of vehicles.
items.cn: 十九世纪随着铁路与繁忙街道的出现，这个词转向指车辆的流动。

items.en: The unlawful sense survives mainly in phrases such as drug trafficking and the verb traffick.
items.cn: 不合法之义主要保存在 drug trafficking 一类说法与动词 traffick 中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the traffic family, and the near-meaning group gathers words for vehicles, congestion, and trade.
note.cn: 形近组收集 traffic 词族，近义组收集表示车辆、拥堵与贸易的词。

entries.definition: a person who deals illegally
illegal trading
a line of vehicles that cannot move
very sad, like a tragedy
entries.definitionCN: 悲惨的，拼写相近而来源不同

entries.definition: cars, buses, and other machines of transport
the state of a road being too full
the carrying of people and goods

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the Italian trade origin, from the uncountable noun, and from the two branches of road flow and illegal dealing.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从意大利语「贸易」来源、不可数名词属性以及「车流」与「非法交易」两条分支入手。

normal.en: Traffic began as trade, so the cars on a road are goods of a sort, moving.
normal.cn: traffic 原是贸易，所以路上的车某种意义上也是流动的货物。

normal.en: As a noun traffic has no plural: say heavy traffic, not many traffics.
normal.cn: 作名词时 traffic 没有复数：说 heavy traffic，而不说 many traffics。

normal.en: The verb doubles the k: trafficked, trafficking, trafficker.
normal.cn: 动词要双写 k：trafficked、trafficking、trafficker。

normal.en: Traffic lights, traffic jam, traffic accident: the word stands in front to say where the flow is short.
normal.cn: traffic lights、traffic jam、traffic accident，本词放前面说明流动受阻之处。

normal.en: Traffic in drugs is the old trade sense surviving in criminal form.
normal.cn: traffic in drugs 是古老贸易义以犯罪形式留存下来的样子。

abstract.en: Picture a river of red tail lights that moves only a few metres at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象一条红色尾灯的河，每次只前挪几米。

abstract.en: Think of ants on a sugar trail, and then make the ants into lorries.
abstract.cn: 想糖迹上的一队蚂蚁，再把蚂蚁换成货车。

abstract.en: Traffic is other people's decisions taking up room on your road.
abstract.cn: 交通就是别人的决定占了你路上的位置。

examples.en: There was a lot of traffic on the coast road this morning.
examples.cn: 今天早上沿海路上车很多。

examples.en: The new traffic lights made the junction much safer.
examples.cn: 新的红绿灯让这个路口安全多了。

examples.en: He was arrested for trafficking in stolen goods.
examples.cn: 他因买卖赃物被捕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳非克」——车子一辆戳着一辆，挤得谁也过不去，就是交通堵。

root: 意大利语 traffico（贸易）→ 法语 trafic → 英语 traffic（贸易 → 车流）。更远来源有争议，可能与表示搬运、往来的词有关。词族有 trafficker、trafficking。

sensesIntro.en: The entry begins with the oldest sense of trade, then turns into the movement of goods, then into the vehicles themselves, then into the flow through networks, and ends with the criminal branch of dealing in forbidden goods.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从「贸易」这一最古老含义出发，转为货物流动，再转为车辆本身，再转为网络中的流量，最后落在买卖违禁品的犯罪分支上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a road thick with moving vehicles.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条挤满移动车辆的路。

branches.en: The cars and buses on the road.
The freight and passengers moved.
The volume passing through a place.
Trade in forbidden goods, noun and verb.
branches.cn: 违禁品买卖，名词与动词。

branches.en: The crowded road that started the circle.
branches.cn: 开启这一循环的拥堵路面。

intro.en: The word is a French borrowing from Italian with no productive suffix, and its small family uses -er and -ing with a doubled k.
intro.cn: 本词是经法语借入的意大利语词，没有能产后缀，其小词族用 -er 与 -ing，并双写 k。

latinIntro.en: There is no certain Latin source, so no Latin entries are listed for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有确定的拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁词条。

items.example: The trade sense survives in traffic in drugs.
items.exampleCN: 贸易义保留在 traffic in drugs 中。

items.example: A trafficker deals in illegal goods.
Trafficking can be stopped at the port.
items.exampleCN: 走私可以在港口被拦住。

items.example: A traffic jam holds the cars still.
Traffic lights regulate the flow.
A traffic accident closed the road.
Heavy traffic slows the whole city.
items.exampleCN: 交通繁忙让整座城市变慢。

items.example: Drug trafficking is severely punished.

definition_zh: 悲剧；惨案；不幸事件；悲剧体裁
definition_en: a very sad event or situation, or a serious play that ends unhappily
core_image: 空荡的舞台上，一只倒下的面具
scene: 最后一幕落下时，主角已经倒在台上，观众席里没有人马上起身鼓掌。The play is a tragedy; everyone on stage loses something by the end.
sceneCN: 这里 tragedy 是「悲剧」（第 1 个义项：结局悲惨的严肃戏剧）；句意说这是一出悲剧，到结尾台上每个人都失去了些什么。

derivatives.zh: 由同一词干加 -ic 构成，义为「悲剧的；悲惨的」
由形容词加 -ally 构成，义为「悲惨地」
由同一词干加 -ian 构成，义为「悲剧演员；悲剧作家」

senses.title: A serious play with an unhappy end
senses.definition: a serious drama in which the main character suffers greatly and usually dies
senses.definitionCN: 主角遭受重大苦难、通常以死亡收场的严肃戏剧
senses.example: We studied three tragedies by Shakespeare this term.
senses.exampleCN: 这学期我们学了三部莎士比亚的悲剧。
senses.why: The Greek word names a specific kind of drama, and the literary sense remains the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 希腊文原名就指某一类戏剧，文学义至今仍是这个词的核心。

senses.title: A very sad event
senses.definition: a terrible event that causes great suffering, such as an accident or a disaster
senses.definitionCN: 造成巨大痛苦的可怕事件，如事故或灾难
senses.example: The fire was a tragedy that the village has never forgotten.
senses.exampleCN: 那场大火是这个村子从未忘掉的惨剧。
senses.why: Real disasters were said to have the shape of a stage tragedy, and the word passed into ordinary life.
senses.whyCN: 现实的灾难被说成具有舞台悲剧的形态，于是这个词进入了日常生活。

senses.title: Great suffering that seems fated
senses.definition: a pattern of suffering that appears inevitable and beyond human control
senses.definitionCN: 看起来无可避免、超出人力控制的一连串苦难
senses.example: The family's story has the slow tragedy of a Greek play.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人的经历有希腊剧那样缓慢的悲剧性。
senses.why: In Greek drama the hero's fall is fated, and that sense of inevitability colours the everyday word.
senses.whyCN: 希腊剧中英雄的坠落是命定的，这种必然感为日常用法染了色。

senses.title: The genre of such plays
senses.definition: the whole class of dramatic works of this kind, often opposed to comedy
senses.definitionCN: 这一类戏剧作品的总称，常与喜剧相对
senses.example: The two masks of the theatre stand for tragedy and comedy.
senses.exampleCN: 剧场的两副面具代表悲剧与喜剧。
senses.why: As a genre, tragedy is a form rather than an event, and criticism keeps the word in this technical sense.
senses.whyCN: 作为体裁，tragedy 是一种形式而非事件，文艺批评一直保持着这个术语义。

senses.title: A regrettable situation
senses.definition: used in the pattern it is a tragedy that to say something is deeply regrettable
senses.definitionCN: 用于 it is a tragedy that 句型，表示某事令人深感痛心
senses.example: It is a tragedy that so many old trees were cut down.
senses.exampleCN: 这么多老树被砍掉，实在令人痛心。
senses.why: The word's weight becomes a way of expressing strong regret, even over things that cost no lives.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的分量成了一种表达强烈遗憾的方式，即使并不涉及生命。

intro.en: Tragedy comes from Greek tragoidia, literally goat-song, from tragos, goat, and aeidein, to sing, probably from the goat given as a prize.
intro.cn: tragedy 来自希腊语 tragoidia，字面是「山羊之歌」，由 tragos（山羊）与 aeidein（歌唱）构成，可能源自律唱比赛的羊奖品。

items.en: Tragoidia is the name of a choral performance in Athens, built from tragos, goat, and ode, song.
items.cn: tragoidia 是雅典一种合唱歌舞的名称，由 tragos（山羊）与 ode（歌）构成。

items.en: The goat may have been the prize for the best chorus, or the animal sacrificed before the performance.
items.cn: 山羊可能是最佳合唱队的奖品，也可能是演出前献祭的牺牲。

items.en: In Athens tragedy becomes the great serious drama of Aeschylus, Sophocles, and Euripides.
items.cn: 在雅典，tragedy 成为埃斯库罗斯、索福克勒斯与欧里庇得斯的伟大严肃戏剧。

items.en: Latin tragoedia borrows the Greek word and passes the dramatic sense to European schools.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tragoedia 借走这个希腊词，并把戏剧含义传给欧洲的学校。

items.en: Middle English tragedy first means a story, often in verse, with a sad ending.
items.cn: 中古英语 tragedy 最初指一个以悲收场的故事，常为韵文。

items.en: From the eighteenth century the word also describes real disasters, and the figurative use widens from there.
items.cn: 十八世纪起，这个词也用来描述真实的灾难，比喻用法自此扩展。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Greek stage family, while the near-meaning group gathers words for disaster and suffering.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一希腊舞台词族的词，近义组收集表示灾难与苦难的词。

entries.definitionCN: 交通，拼写相近而来源不同

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the goat-song origin, from the theatre masks, and from the pattern it is a tragedy that.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「山羊之歌」的来源、剧场面具以及 it is a tragedy that 句型入手。

normal.en: Tragos plus ode: goat song. The strange name survives inside the serious play.
normal.cn: tragos 加 ode，就是山羊之歌。这个古怪的名字藏在严肃戏剧里面。

normal.en: Two masks: the smiling one is comedy, the weeping one is tragedy.
normal.cn: 两副面具：笑的那副是喜剧，哭的那副是悲剧。

normal.en: Tragedy as a genre ends badly; tragedy as an event hurts now.
normal.cn: 作为体裁的悲剧结局不好；作为事件的悲剧当下就伤人。

normal.en: It is a tragedy that plus a fact is a formal way of saying something is deeply sad.
normal.cn: it is a tragedy that 加一个事实，是表达「令人深感痛心」的正规说法。

normal.en: The -dy ending is not a suffix, so remove nothing: the whole word is the root.
normal.cn: 词尾 -dy 不是后缀，不要拆掉，整个词就是词根。

abstract.en: Picture a single actor alone on a lit stage after everyone else has left.
abstract.cn: 想象灯还亮着，别人都走了，台上只剩一个演员。

abstract.en: Think of a goat standing quietly at the back of a Greek chorus, waiting to be a prize.
abstract.cn: 想一只山羊安静地站在希腊合唱队后面，等着当奖品。

abstract.en: A tragedy is a loss that could not have been stopped in time.
abstract.cn: 悲剧是一场来不及被拦住的失去。

examples.en: The accident on the bridge was a terrible tragedy.
examples.cn: 桥上的那场事故是可怕的惨剧。

examples.en: He wrote three tragedies before he was thirty.
examples.cn: 他三十岁前写了三部悲剧。

examples.en: It is a tragedy that she left the course so early.
examples.cn: 她这么早就离开课程，实在可惜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹几只」——舞台上踹倒了那几只面具，悲剧开场。

root: 希腊语 tragoidia（山羊之歌）= tragos（山羊）+ ode（歌）→ 拉丁语 tragoedia → 中古英语 tragedy。同族词有 tragic、tragically、tragedian。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts with the stage play, moves to real disasters that move like a play, then to the sense of fated suffering, then back to the genre in criticism, and ends with the phrase of deep regret.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从舞台剧开始，转到像戏一样展开的现实灾难，再指命定的苦难，又回到文艺批评中的体裁义，最后落在表达深切遗憾的句型上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stage emptied by a story that ends in loss.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个以失去收场的故事所留下的空舞台。

branches.en: The play itself.
The real event with that shape.
branches.cn: 具有这种形态的真实事件。

branches.en: The sense that the pain was unavoidable.
branches.cn: 那种痛苦无可避免的感觉。

branches.en: The genre name in criticism.
The phrase for sharp regret.

intro.en: The word is a Greek compound whose parts are no longer felt as separate; English builds its family with -ic, -ally, and -ian.
intro.cn: 本词是希腊语复合词，各部件在英语中已不再被感知为独立成分；英语用 -ic、-ally、-ian 构成词族。

latinIntro.en: The Greek parts below are the compound's original pieces, carried into Latin as tragoedia.
latinIntro.cn: 下面列出这个希腊复合词的原始部件，它们以 tragoedia 的形式进入拉丁语。

items.example: Tragos is the first half of the compound.
Ode is the second half of the compound.
Tragic means relating to tragedy.
Tragically modifies a whole sentence.
A tragedian is an actor or writer of tragedy.
items.exampleCN: tragedian 是悲剧演员或作家。

items.example: The ending comes from the Latinized form.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾来自拉丁化形式。

items.example: The goat is the picture under the word.
items.exampleCN: 山羊是这个词底下的画面。

items.example: The chorus sang the song that named the genre.
items.exampleCN: 合唱队唱的歌给这一体裁命名。

definition_zh: 小路；踪迹；尾迹；（作动词）拖；跟随；落后
definition_en: a rough path through open country, or the marks left by something moving, and to drag or follow behind
core_image: 一条在草丛中被踩出来的细线，一路通向山口
scene: 山脚的草地上有一条被走过的细线，弯弯地通到松林深处。We followed a narrow trail up through the pines to the ridge.
sceneCN: 这里 trail 是「小路」（第 1 个义项：原野中走出来的粗糙小道）；句意为我们沿着一条窄窄的小路穿过松林走到山脊。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成，义为「拖车；预告片」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「拖着的；尾随的」

senses.title: A rough path through the country
senses.definition: a narrow path worn through a wild or open area, often used for walking
senses.definitionCN: 在荒野或旷野中被踩出的窄道，多供步行
senses.example: The trail climbs steeply after the second bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 过了第二座桥，小路就开始陡峭地上升。
senses.why: The Latin root is a drag or a pull, so a trail is a line dragged through the grass by feet.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为拖、拉，所以小路就是脚步在草上拖出的一条线。

senses.title: Marks left by a moving thing
senses.definition: the prints, scent, or signs left behind by a person or animal
senses.definitionCN: 人或动物身后留下的印迹、气味或迹象
senses.example: The dogs found the trail again at the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 狗在溪边又找到了那股踪迹。
senses.why: What is dragged along leaves a mark, so the mark itself takes the name of the dragging.
senses.whyCN: 被拖着的东西会留下印记，于是印记本身也沿用了「拖」这个名字。

senses.title: Something dragging behind
senses.definition: a long part of something, such as a dress or smoke, that hangs or stretches behind
senses.definitionCN: 衣裙、烟雾等长长拖在后面的部分
senses.example: The bride's dress had a long lace trail.
senses.exampleCN: 新娘的礼服拖着长长的蕾丝尾。
senses.why: The physical act of dragging becomes the very thing that is dragged along behind.
senses.whyCN: 拖这个动作本身就变成了被拖在后面的那样东西。

senses.title: To drag along the ground
senses.definition: to let something hang down and be pulled along behind one
senses.definitionCN: 让某物垂下并被拉着在身后移动
senses.example: The child trailed a stick through the dust.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子拖着一根棍子在土里划过去。
senses.why: This is the literal source of every other sense, acted out by hand.
senses.whyCN: 这是其他所有义项的字面来源，用动作直接演示出来。

senses.title: To follow behind someone
senses.definition: to walk or move slowly behind another person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 在别人或别物后面慢慢走或移动
senses.example: The little boy trailed his mother across the market.
senses.exampleCN: 小男孩跟在母亲身后穿过集市。
senses.why: If something is dragged behind you, it follows you, and a person can follow in the same manner.
senses.whyCN: 如果一样东西被你拖在身后，它就跟着你，人也可以以同样的方式跟随。

senses.title: To be losing in a contest
senses.definition: to be behind a competitor in score, speed, or progress
senses.definitionCN: 在比分、速度或进度上落在对手后面
senses.example: Our team trailed by two goals at half time.
senses.exampleCN: 半场时我们队落后两球。
senses.why: To be behind in space becomes to be behind in score, since contests are pictured as races along a track.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的在后成为比分上的落后，因为竞赛被想象成轨道上的赛跑。

intro.en: Trail comes through Old French traillier, to drag, from Latin tragula, a small dragnet or sled, related to trahere, to pull.
intro.cn: trail 经古法语 traillier（拖）而来，源自拉丁语 tragula（小拖网、拖橇），并与 trahere（拉）相关。

items.en: Tragula is a dragnet or sled that is hauled along the ground behind a person or animal.
items.cn: tragula 是被拖着在地上移动的拖网或拖橇。

items.en: Old French traillier means to drag along, to haul, or to draw a net.
items.cn: 古法语 traillier 意为沿地拖、拉或拖网。

items.en: English takes the verb trail for dragging, and soon uses the noun for the line left behind.
items.cn: 英语借入动词 trail 表示拖，很快又用名词指身后留下的线。

items.en: In the North American forests trail becomes the usual word for a walking path.
items.cn: 在北美的森林里，trail 成为步道的常用词。

items.en: The sense of being behind in a contest develops in the nineteenth century with organised sport.
items.cn: 竞赛中落后的含义在十九世纪随着有组织的体育运动发展出来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the trail family and pulling relatives, while the near-meaning group gathers paths and marks of passage.
note.cn: 形近组收集 trail 词族与拖拽相关的词，近义组收集路径与经过的印记。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the dragging root, from the compound habits, and from the picture of a line in the grass.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「拖」这个词根、复合搭配以及草丛里的那条线入手。

normal.en: Tragula is a dragnet pulled along the ground, so trail is always about dragging.
normal.cn: tragula 是被拖着走的拖网，所以 trail 始终围绕「拖」。

normal.en: Trail behind, on the trail of, blaze a trail: the word covers following, tracking, and pioneering.
normal.cn: trail behind、on the trail of、blaze a trail，分别覆盖落后、追踪、开创。

normal.en: Drag something and it follows, which is why the same word means both pull and follow.
normal.cn: 把东西一拖，它就跟着走，这就是同一个词既指拖又指跟的原因。

normal.en: A trailer is a thing towed behind, and a film trailer drags you into the cinema.
normal.cn: trailer 是被拖在后面的车，而电影预告片则是把你「拖」进影院。

normal.en: Trail and track are cousins: one is dragged, the other is cut.
normal.cn: trail 与 track 是表亲：一个是拖出来的，一个是刻出来的。

abstract.en: Picture a thin line pressed into tall grass, the only sign that anyone passed.
abstract.cn: 想象长草里被压出的一条细线，是有人经过的唯一证据。

abstract.en: Think of a scarf pulled along the ground and slowly collecting dust.
abstract.cn: 想一条被拖着走的围巾，慢慢沾满尘土。

abstract.en: A trail is the ground remembering a path.
abstract.cn: 小路是土地对走过的路的记忆。

examples.en: The trail leads down to a small lake.
examples.cn: 这条小路通向一个小湖。

examples.en: Police are on the trail of the missing car.
examples.cn: 警方正在追踪那辆失踪的车。

examples.en: She trailed a scarf along the railing as she walked.
examples.cn: 她一边走一边让围巾沿着栏杆拖过去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「追噢」——追着脚印往前噢，脚下踩出的就是小路。

root: 拉丁语 tragula（拖网、拖橇，与 trahere「拉」相关）→ 古法语 traillier（拖）→ 中古英语 trail。词族有 trailer、trailing。

sensesIntro.en: Everything begins with dragging: the drag leaves a line in the grass, that line becomes a path, the line behind a thing becomes its marks or its hanging end, and a follower can drag behind in a race.
sensesIntro.cn: 一切都从「拖」开始：拖动在草上留下一条线，这条线成为小路，身后那条线成为踪迹或垂下的尾，而跟随者也会在竞赛中拖在后面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something pulled along the ground leaving a line.
core.cn: 核心意象：某物被沿地拖动，留下一条线。

branches.en: The path formed by the dragging.
The marks left behind.
The part that hangs and trails.
The act of dragging and of following.
The following that becomes losing.

intro.en: The word is a French borrowing from a Latin dragnet, with no productive suffix, and its family uses -er and -ing.
intro.cn: 本词是经法语借入的拉丁「拖网」词，没有能产后缀，其词族用 -er 与 -ing。

latinIntro.en: The Latin dragnet and the pulling verb behind it are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 下面列出这一族的拉丁「拖网」以及它背后的「拉」动词。

items.example: The stem survives in trail and trailer.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干留在 trail 与 trailer 里。

items.meaning: one that does, or a thing that
items.meaningCN: 做某事者；用于某事的物
items.example: A trailer is pulled behind.
Trailing is the act of dragging behind.
Trails is plural and verb form.
items.exampleCN: trails 既是复数也是动词形式。

items.meaning: to mark trees on a new path
items.example: To blaze a trail is to open the way.
items.exampleCN: blaze a trail 就是开出一条路。

items.example: A walking trail is for foot travel.
A foot trail is the narrowest kind.
items.exampleCN: foot trail 是最窄的一种。

items.example: A snow trail is marked for skiers.
items.exampleCN: 雪道是给滑雪者标出的。

definition_zh: 火车；列车；一系列；随从；（作动词）训练；培养
definition_en: a line of connected railway carriages pulled by an engine, or a connected series of things; and to teach or practise a skill
core_image: 一节车厢连着一节车厢，由前面的机车拉着往前走
scene: 站台上的人把箱子往前挪了挪，远处一列长长的车正慢慢地收住速度。The train pulled into the station exactly on time.
sceneCN: 这里 train 是「火车、列车」（第 1 个义项：由机车牵引的一列车厢）；句意为那列火车准点驶进了车站。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「训练；培训」
由动词加 -ee 构成，义为「受训者」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「教练；训练者」

senses.title: Railway carriages pulled by an engine
senses.definition: a line of railway carriages or wagons joined together and pulled by an engine
senses.definitionCN: 由机车牵引、首尾相连的一列铁路车厢
senses.example: The night train to the coast leaves at ten.
senses.exampleCN: 去海边的夜车十点发车。
senses.why: The French source means something dragged along, and a train is literally a line of things dragged behind an engine.
senses.whyCN: 法语来源意为被拖着的东西，而火车字面上就是一串被拖在机车后面的东西。

senses.title: A connected series of things
senses.definition: a sequence of events, ideas, or objects that follow one after another
senses.definitionCN: 一个接一个相继发生的事件、想法或物件
senses.example: The news broke his train of thought completely.
senses.exampleCN: 这个消息把他的思路彻底打断了。
senses.why: A line of carriages is the model for any line of things, so the word becomes a general word for series.
senses.whyCN: 一串车厢是任何一串事物的模型，于是这个词成为泛指「系列」的词。

senses.title: The followers of an important person
senses.definition: a group of servants or attendants travelling behind a person of rank
senses.definitionCN: 跟在显贵身后同行的一群仆从或随员
senses.example: The queen arrived with a train of forty attendants.
senses.exampleCN: 女王带着四十名随从到来。
senses.why: People following in order are dragged behind in a line, just as carriages are, so the word covers a retinue.
senses.whyCN: 按次序跟着的人正如车厢一样被拖成一列，所以这个词也指随行队伍。

senses.title: The long back part of a dress
senses.definition: the long part of a formal dress or robe that drags behind the wearer
senses.definitionCN: 礼服或长袍身后拖地的长摆
senses.example: Two children carried the bride's train up the steps.
senses.exampleCN: 两个孩子把新娘的裙裾提上台阶。
senses.why: The dragging part of a garment is the most physical remnant of the original dragging sense.
senses.whyCN: 衣袍被拖着的部分，是原始「拖」义最具体的遗留。

senses.title: To teach and practise a skill
senses.definition: to teach a person or animal a skill through repeated practice
senses.definitionCN: 通过反复练习教人或动物掌握某项技能
senses.example: She trains new staff for six weeks before they start.
senses.exampleCN: 新员工上岗前她培训他们六周。
senses.why: From dragging things in a line comes the idea of leading someone along a course, and so of forming them by practice.
senses.whyCN: 从把事物拖成一列，发展出把人带着走完一段课程的想法，于是形成「以练习培养」之义。

senses.title: To prepare for a contest
senses.definition: to exercise and practise regularly in order to be ready for a sport or event
senses.definitionCN: 为备战某项运动或赛事而定期锻炼练习
senses.example: He trains in the pool every morning at six.
senses.exampleCN: 他每天早上六点在泳池里训练。
senses.why: The person being formed by practice can also form himself, so the verb becomes intransitive.
senses.whyCN: 被练习塑造的人也可以自己塑造自己，于是这个动词有了不及物用法。

intro.en: Train comes from Old French trahiner, to drag, from Latin trahere, to pull; the sense of a railway train dates from the 1820s.
intro.cn: train 来自古法语 trahiner（拖），源自拉丁语 trahere（拉）；表示火车的意思始于十九世纪二十年代。

items.en: Trahere means to pull or drag, and its stem underlies a large family in English.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、拖，其词干在英语中撑起一个大家族。

items.en: Trahiner means to drag along, and the noun train means something dragged or a line of things.
items.cn: 古法语 trahiner 意为沿地拖，名词 train 意为被拖之物或一列东西。

items.en: English borrows train for a trailing part, a retinue, and a sequence of events.
items.cn: 英语借入 train，指拖尾部分、随从以及一连串事件。

items.en: With the railways of the 1820s the word settles on the line of carriages, which becomes its dominant sense.
items.cn: 十九世纪二十年代铁路出现后，这个词固定在「一列车厢」上，成为其主要含义。

items.en: The verb to train, meaning to bring a person or animal along by practice, is older and grows in use with armies and schools.
items.cn: 动词 train 意为通过练习把人或动物培养出来，这一用法更早，并随军队与学校的发展而增多。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the -ing, -ee, and -er forms, while the near-meaning group gathers rail terms and teaching words.
note.cn: 形近组收集 -ing、-ee、-er 等形式，近义组收集铁路术语与教学类词。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the dragging origin, from the compound phrases, and from the -ing, -ee, -er family.
normalIntro.cn: 「拖」的原义、常用搭配以及 -ing、-ee、-er 词族入手。

normal.en: A train is a line of things dragged along, so the carriages and the dress train are the same picture.
normal.cn: 火车是一串被拖着走的东西，所以车厢与裙裾是同一幅画面。

normal.en: Train of thought: thoughts follow one after another like carriages.
normal.cn: train of thought，想法像车厢一样一节接一节。

normal.en: Training is the activity, a trainee is the person learning, a trainer is the person teaching.
normal.cn: training 是活动，trainee 是学习的人，trainer 是教的人。

normal.en: By train, catch a train, miss a train: the transport sense takes articles freely.
normal.cn: by train、catch a train、miss a train，交通义可以自由加冠词。

normal.en: To train is to walk someone along a course until the skill sticks.
normal.cn: to train 就是带着某人走完一段课程，直到技能定型。

abstract.en: Picture a long dark line of carriages curving into the station.
abstract.cn: 想象一列深色车厢弯进车站的长长的样子。

abstract.en: Think of a queen's long robe held up by two children on stone steps.
abstract.cn: 想女王的长袍在两个孩子的搀扶下走过石阶。

abstract.en: A train is a plan made of steel, always arriving before its own end.
abstract.cn: 火车是用钢做成的计划，总在自己终点之前先到站。

examples.en: We took the early train to the city.
examples.cn: 我们坐早班车进城。

examples.en: The letter broke my train of thought.
examples.cn: 这封信打断了我的思路。

examples.en: The dogs are trained to search for people in snow.
examples.cn: 这些狗受过在雪中寻人的训练。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扯你」——前面机车一扯，后面的车厢全跟着走，就是一列车。

root: 拉丁语 trahere（拉、拖）→ 古法语 trahiner（沿地拖）→ 中古英语 train（拖尾、随从、序列）→ 近代英语 train（列车；训练）。词族有 training、trainee、trainer。

sensesIntro.en: Everything starts from dragging: the dragged line gives carriages and dress trains, the line of followers gives a retinue, the line of events gives a series, and the leading of people along a course gives the verb to train.
sensesIntro.cn: 一切都从拖拽开始：被拖的线给出车厢与裙裾，跟成一列的人给出随从，排成一串的事件给出系列，而带着人走完课程则给出动词「训练」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line of connected things pulled along in order.
core.cn: 核心意象：一串相连之物依序被拉着前行。

branches.en: The railway train.
Any series in a line.
Followers in line and cloth dragged behind.
branches.cn: 排成一列的随从与身后的拖布。

branches.en: Leading someone along a course of practice.
branches.cn: 带着人走完练习的课程。

branches.en: The learner's own repeated practice.
branches.cn: 学习者自身的反复练习。

definition_zh: 训练；培训；锻炼；（动物）驯养
definition_en: the process of teaching or being taught the skills needed for a job, sport, or activity
core_image: 操场上反复跑动的身影，一天接一天
scene: 天还没亮，跑道上已经有几个人在跑第四圈，呼吸白得像雾。She is in training for the marathon and runs every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 training 是「训练」（第 1 个义项：为掌握技能或备战而反复练习的过程）；句意为她正在为马拉松训练，每天早上都跑。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「训练」；也指名次「火车」
由 train 加 -ee 构成，义为「受训者」
由 train 加 -er 构成，义为「教练」

senses.title: The process of learning a job
senses.definition: the teaching and practice that prepares someone for a job or task
senses.definitionCN: 为某份工作或任务做准备的教学与练习
senses.example: New staff get two weeks of training before they start.
senses.exampleCN: 新员工上岗前要接受两周培训。
senses.why: The -ing form names the activity of the verb train, and this is its most general sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个 -ing 形式指动词 train 的活动本身，这是它最一般的义项。

senses.title: Regular exercise for a sport
senses.definition: the regular exercise and practice an athlete does to prepare for competition
senses.definitionCN: 运动员为备战比赛而做的定期锻炼与练习
senses.example: Her training includes swimming twice a week.
senses.exampleCN: 她的训练包括每周游泳两次。
senses.why: Sport makes the forming of skill visible, day after day, and this sense is now the most familiar.
senses.whyCN: 体育让技能的塑造日复一日地可见，这一义项如今最为人所熟悉。

senses.title: The teaching of an animal
senses.definition: the work of teaching an animal to obey and perform tasks
senses.definitionCN: 教动物服从并执行任务的工作
senses.example: Dog training takes patience and a great many small rewards.
senses.exampleCN: 驯狗需要耐心和许多小小的奖励。
senses.why: Animals as well as people can be brought along a course of practice, so the same noun covers them.
senses.whyCN: 动物同人一样能被带着走完练习课程，所以同一个名词也覆盖它们。

senses.title: A state of being prepared
senses.definition: the condition of being fit and ready, especially in the phrase in training
senses.definitionCN: 处于体能与准备就绪的状态，尤见于 in training
senses.example: The whole team is in training for the spring games.
senses.exampleCN: 全队都在为春季运动会训练。
senses.why: The activity becomes a state one can be in, so the noun describes readiness rather than the exercises.
senses.whyCN: 这种活动变成可以置身其中一种状态，于是名词描述的是准备程度而非练习本身。

senses.title: Education for a profession
senses.definition: the formal preparation for a profession such as teaching or medicine
senses.definitionCN: 为教师、医生等职业所做的正规准备
senses.example: Teacher training now includes a full year in school.
senses.exampleCN: 如今的师资培训包含一整年的在校实践。
senses.why: Long professional preparation is named by the same word because it is the same practice over a longer course.
senses.whyCN: 长期的专业准备用同一个词，因为它只是把同样的练习拉到了更长的课程上。

intro.en: Training is the noun from the verb train, whose French source trahiner, to drag, goes back to Latin trahere, to pull.
intro.cn: training 是由动词 train 派生的名词，train 来自古法语 trahiner（拖），其源头是拉丁语 trahere（拉）。

items.en: Trahere means to pull or draw, and its participle tractus underlies many English words.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、拖，其分词 tractus 支撑许多英语词。

items.en: Trahiner means to drag along, and from it English takes the verb train.
items.cn: 古法语 trahiner 意为沿地拖，英语的动词 train 由此而来。

items.en: By the sixteenth century to train means to lead a person by practice into a skill.
items.cn: 十六世纪时 to train 已意为通过练习把人带入某项技能。

items.en: The noun training spreads with armies, schools, and later with organised sport in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 名词 training 随军队、学校以及十九世纪有组织的体育运动而传播。

items.en: Job training and on-the-job training become fixed phrases of industry in the twentieth century.
items.cn: job training 与 on-the-job training 在二十世纪成为工业界的固定说法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the train family, while the near-meaning group gathers words for teaching, practice, and preparation.
note.cn: 形近组收集 train 词族，近义组收集表示教学、练习与准备的词。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the -ing formation, from the fixed phrases with receive and in, and from the picture of the early track.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从 -ing 构词、receive training 与 in training 固定搭配以及清晨跑道画面入手。

normal.en: Train plus -ing: the -ing turns the verb of teaching into the whole activity and its sessions.
normal.cn: train 加 -ing，这个后缀把「教」的动词变成整个活动及其课程。

normal.en: In training is a state; training course is a thing you attend.
normal.cn: in training 是一种状态，training course 是你要去上的课。

normal.en: A trainee is acted upon, a trainer acts, and training is the action between them.
normal.cn: 受训者被施加，教练施加，而 training 是两者之间的行动。

normal.en: Training as a noun is uncountable: say two weeks of training, not two trainings.
normal.cn: 作为名词不可数：说 two weeks of training，不说 two trainings。

normal.en: Every skill is a line of practice followed until it becomes easy.
normal.cn: 每项技能都是一条练习出来的线，走到它变容易为止。

abstract.en: Picture a white line on a track, passed over again and again before sunrise.
abstract.cn: 想象跑道上的白线，在日出前被一次又一次越过。

abstract.en: Think of a whistle sounding, then the same movement repeated exactly.
abstract.cn: 想哨声一响，同一个动作被一模一样地重复。

abstract.en: Training is patience turned into habit.
abstract.cn: 训练是被养成习惯的耐心。

examples.en: All drivers here receive two days of safety training.
examples.cn: 这里所有司机都要接受两天安全培训。

examples.en: He is in training for the hill race.
examples.cn: 他正在为山地赛跑训练。

examples.en: The training of young horses takes years.
examples.cn: 驯养年轻马匹要花好几年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹宁」——教练一吹哨，宁可累也要再来一遍，这就是训练。

root: 拉丁语 trahere（拉、拖）→ 古法语 trahiner（拖）→ 英语动词 train（培养）→ train + -ing → training。词族有 trainee、trainer。

sensesIntro.en: The noun begins with the general activity of forming skill, narrows to sport and to animals, rises into a state of readiness, and widens again into formal professional education.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词先指塑造技能的一般活动，收窄到体育与动物，上升为准备就绪的状态，再扩展为正规的专业教育。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one movement repeated until it becomes easy.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个动作被重复到变容易为止。

items.example: A trainee is trained by a trainer.

definition_zh: 拖车；挂车；拖斗；房车；预告片
definition_en: a vehicle or container without an engine that is pulled behind another vehicle, or a short piece of film advertising a longer one
core_image: 一辆小货车后面挂着一只没有轮子驱动的铁箱，跟着前车在路上走
scene: 电影开场前的十分钟里，银幕上连放了三个新片预告。The audience hushed as the first trailer flickered onto the screen.
sceneCN: 这里 trailer 是「预告片」（第 4 个义项：正片前放映的短片）；句意为第一部预告片在银幕上闪起时，观众安静了下来。画面里是昏暗的影院与发亮的银幕。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成名词所依附的基础词，义为「拖；拉；尾随」
由动词加 -ing 构成形容词，义为「拖着的；后面的」
由名词加 -ful 构成，义为「一拖车的量」

senses.title: A container pulled behind a vehicle
senses.definition: an unpowered container or platform that is towed by a car, van, or lorry
senses.definitionCN: 由汽车、货车牵引、自身没有动力的箱体或平台
senses.example: They loaded the furniture onto a trailer and drove north.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把家具装上拖车，向北开去。
senses.why: The word is simply trail plus the agent suffix -er, so the thing is named for what it does: it trails behind.
senses.whyCN: 这个词只是 trail 加施事后缀 -er，器物按它的动作命名——它总是跟在后面拖行。

senses.title: A home that can be towed
senses.definition: a large trailer fitted out with beds and a kitchen for living in
senses.definitionCN: 装有床铺和厨房、可供居住的大型拖车
senses.example: For two summers the family lived in a trailer beside the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 有两个夏天，这家人就住在湖边的住宿拖车里。
senses.why: Once a trailer carries people rather than goods, it becomes a movable house, and the same noun covers it.
senses.whyCN: 当拖车装的是人而不是货物，它就成了可以移动的房子，同一个名词就兼指两者。

senses.title: Something that follows in a line
senses.definition: a part attached to the back of something and moving along with it
senses.definitionCN: 附着在别物后面随之移动的部分
senses.example: The last trailer of the wedding convoy was still lost in the village.
senses.exampleCN: 婚礼车队最后那一节还困在村里没出来。
senses.why: This is the oldest layer of the image: anything that hangs on behind and follows is a trailer.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心意象最古老的一层：任何挂在后面跟着走的东西都叫 trailer。

senses.title: A short piece of film advertising a longer one
senses.definition: a brief extract shown before a feature film to advertise it
senses.definitionCN: 正片之前放映、用于宣传正片的短片
senses.example: The trailer gave away the ending, which annoyed everyone who saw it.
senses.exampleCN: 预告片把结局泄露了，让看过的人都恼火。
senses.why: A trailer once trailed behind the main attraction at a cinema; later it was moved to the front but kept the name.
senses.whyCN: 早期这类短片确实排在影院正片之后，后来虽移到前面放映，名字却没改。

senses.title: A goods vehicle without an engine
senses.definition: the cargo section of a lorry, separable from the cab that pulls it
senses.definitionCN: 货车上与牵引车头可分离的载货部分
senses.example: The driver unhooked the trailer at the depot and took a new one.
senses.exampleCN: 司机在货站摘下挂车，换上了一辆新的。
senses.why: The unpowered cargo half of a lorry is nothing but a trailing box, so the old literal sense still holds.
senses.whyCN: 货车后面那个没有动力的货箱就是一只被拖着的箱子，古老的字面义依然成立。

senses.title: The last part of a news broadcast
senses.definition: a final item at the end of a programme, especially a light one
senses.definitionCN: 节目结尾的一个条目，通常是轻松的那一个
senses.example: The news ended with a trailer about the village fair.
senses.exampleCN: 新闻以一条关于村集市的尾声报道结束。
senses.why: Borrowed from the cinema sense, this use treats the closing item as something tagging along behind the main news.
senses.whyCN: 这个用法借自电影义项，把收尾条目看作跟在主体新闻后面的东西。

intro.en: Trailer is an English coinage on the verb trail, from Old French traillier, to drag, which goes back to Latin trahere, to pull.
intro.cn: trailer 是由动词 trail 派生的英语自造词，trail 来自古法语 traillier（拖），再上溯到拉丁语 trahere（拉）。

items.en: Trahere means to draw or pull, and its stem gives English many words of drawing and dragging.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、牵引，其词干在英语中衍生出许多表示拉拽的词。

items.en: Old French traillier means to drag along the ground or to follow in someone's track.
items.cn: 古法语 traillier 意为沿地面拖行，或跟在某人的足迹之后。

items.en: English takes the verb trail for dragging and for following, and the noun trail for a dragged path.
items.cn: 英语借入动词 trail，表示拖行与跟踪，名词 trail 则指被拖出的路径。

items.en: The nineteenth century forms trailer as the name for a thing towed behind another, at first of a wagon attachment.
items.cn: 十九世纪出现 trailer，用来称呼被别的车拖着走的东西，最初指马车的附加车厢。

items.en: With the motor car the sense widens to caravan and cargo trailer, and with the cinema it shifts to the advertising short.
items.cn: 随着汽车普及，词义扩展到房车与载货挂车；随着电影出现，又转为指宣传短片。

note.en: The look-alike group collects forms built on trail and near-spellings in lorry jargon, while the near-meaning group gathers other towed or moving-home words.
note.cn: 形近组收集由 trail 构成的形式以及货车行话中的近似拼法，近义组汇集其他被牵引的、可移动居住的词语。

a vehicle towed behind a car for living in on holiday
a showing of a film before it opens generally

normalIntro.en: The group of forms built on trail gives several hooks: the verb, the -er thing, and the -ing shape.
normalIntro.cn: 由 trail 构成的一组形式提供几个抓手：动词、加 -er 的器物、加 -ing 的形态。

normal.en: Trail plus -er means the thing that trails, which is exactly a towed box.
normal.cn: trail 加 -er 就是「拖行的那个东西」，正是被牵引的箱子。

normal.en: The same -er that turns teach into teacher turns trail into trailer.
normal.cn: 让 teach 变成 teacher 的那个 -er，也让 trail 变成 trailer。

normal.en: In lorry work the cab pulls and the trailer is pulled, so the word marks the passive half.
normal.cn: 在货运里，车头负责拉、挂车被拉，这个词标记的正是被动的那一半。

normal.en: A trailer for a film trails the story in miniature ahead of the full version.
normal.cn: 电影预告片把故事浓缩成小样，先于完整版出现。

normal.en: The caravan sense follows because a trailer can carry beds as easily as bricks.
normal.cn: 房车义项顺理成章，因为拖车既能装砖，也能铺床。

abstract.en: Picture a small iron box leaping behind a car, its wheels spinning with no engine of their own.
abstract.cn: 想象一只铁皮箱在汽车后面颠着走，轮子转得飞快却自己没有发动机。

abstract.en: Hear the bump as it crosses a pothole, a sound that no engine can make.
abstract.cn: 听它压过坑洼时的那一声闷响，那是发动机发不出的声音。

abstract.en: Then shrink the whole trailer into a ten-second screen of flickering images.
abstract.cn: 再把整辆拖车缩成十秒钟跳动的小画面。

examples.en: He hooked the trailer to the back of the van before dawn.
examples.cn: 天亮前他把拖车挂到了货车后面。

examples.en: The trailer for the new film ran twice before the main feature.
examples.cn: 新片的预告片在正片之前放了两遍。

examples.en: Trailers heavier than a set weight need a special licence.
examples.cn: 超过规定重量的挂车需要特殊驾照。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹了」——车头一开，后面的箱子被吹着走，就是拖车。

root: 英语动词 trail（拖；拉）加施事后缀 -er；trail 来自古法语 traillier，源自拉丁语 trahere（拉；牵引）

sensesIntro.en: All senses keep the same picture, something hanging on behind and moving with a puller, from cargo box to caravan to the short film that follows the feature.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项共享同一幅画面：挂在后面、被牵着走的东西，从货箱到房车，再到跟在正片后面的短片。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an engineless box towed along behind a pulling vehicle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只没有动力、被前车拖着走的箱子。

branches.en: The literal family: the towed box, the part that follows, and the lorry's cargo half.
branches.cn: 字面一族：被拖的箱子、跟随的部分、货车的载货半截。

branches.en: The dwelling sense, where a trailer carries people instead of goods.
branches.cn: 居住义：拖车装的是人而不是货物。

branches.en: The cinema sense, where the trailing short became an opening advertisement.
branches.cn: 电影义：跟在后面的短片变成了开场广告。

branches.en: The broadcast sense, where the closing item tags along after the news.
branches.cn: 广播义：收尾条目跟在新闻之后。

branches.en: Both senses move the word from transport to culture, keeping the image of something towed.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把这个词从运输带进文化领域，而「被牵引」的画面始终不变。

intro.en: The word is a plain English derivative, so its affix story is the agent suffix -er on a verb.
intro.cn: 这是个普通的英语派生词，词缀故事就是动词后加施事后缀 -er。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source trahere supplies the stem, while -er is native English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 提供词干，而 -er 是英语本族后缀。

items.example: Trail gives trailer as teach gives teacher.
items.exampleCN: trail 生 trailer，正如 teach 生 teacher。

items.example: The scarf trailed in the mud.
She wore a trailing gown.

items.meaning: one that does or is something
items.meaningCN: 做某事或充当某物的人或物
items.example: A cooker cooks, and a trailer trails.
items.exampleCN: cooker 用来煮，trailer 用来拖。

items.meaning: the start of a walking path
items.example: We met at the trailhead at six.
items.exampleCN: 我们六点在步道起点碰头。

items.meaning: a pioneer who marks a new path
items.example: She was a trailblazer for women in science.
items.exampleCN: 她是科学界女性的开路先锋。

items.example: This boat is trailerable behind a small car.
items.exampleCN: 这条船能用小汽车拖运。

items.meaning: a site where trailers are parked as homes
items.example: They bought a plot in a trailer park.
items.exampleCN: 他们在拖车营地里买了一块地。

definition_zh: 交易；业务；办理；事务；和解
definition_en: an act of buying, selling, or exchanging something, or the process of doing business with someone
core_image: 两双手隔着柜台把东西推过去、把东西拉过来，一来一往
scene: 银行柜台前，柜员把存单递出来请客户签字。Every transaction over five thousand yuan must be signed by the customer.
sceneCN: 这里 transaction 是「交易、业务办理」（第 1 个义项：买卖或钱财往来）；句意为每笔五千元以上的交易都必须由客户签字。画面里有柜台、存单与签字笔。

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词后缀 -ion 还原为动词，义为「办理；进行交易」
由名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「交易的；事务性的」
由动词加 -or 构成，义为「交易者；办理人」

senses.title: An act of buying or selling
senses.definition: a single act of exchanging money for goods or services
senses.definitionCN: 一次用钱换取货物或服务的往来
senses.example: Each transaction is printed on the receipt.
senses.exampleCN: 每笔交易都打印在收据上。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to drive through or carry out, and a deal is something driven through to the end.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词本义是「推行、办成」，一笔买卖正是被一路推到完成的事。

senses.title: The handling of a piece of business
senses.definition: the doing or carrying out of a matter, especially official business
senses.definitionCN: 把一件事办完，尤指公务上的办理
senses.example: The transaction of the case took three months.
senses.exampleCN: 这个案子的办理花了三个月。
senses.why: Before it meant a deal, the word meant simply getting a matter done, and that older sense survives in formal prose.
senses.whyCN: 在表示买卖之前，这个词只表示把事办完，这个古老含义留在正式文体里。

senses.title: Dealings between people or bodies
senses.definition: the activity of doing business or exchanging views with another party
senses.definitionCN: 与另一方做生意或交换意见的活动
senses.example: The two firms kept their transactions short and formal.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司的往来简短而正式。
senses.why: A transaction is always across something, from one party to the other, which is what the prefix trans- marks.
senses.whyCN: 交易总是跨过某个界限、从一方到另一方，这正是前缀 trans- 所标记的。

senses.title: A record of money moved
senses.definition: a single entry recording money paid in or out
senses.definitionCN: 记录一笔进出款项的条目
senses.example: The bank lists every transaction from the past year.
senses.exampleCN: 银行列出了过去一年的每一笔账目。
senses.why: Once deals are written into books, the written line itself comes to be called a transaction.
senses.whyCN: 交易一旦记进账簿，那一行字本身也被称为一笔 transaction。

senses.title: A settlement between parties
senses.definition: an arrangement that settles a dispute or account between two sides
senses.definitionCN: 使双方争执或债务得以了结的安排
senses.example: The dispute ended in an amicable transaction out of court.
senses.exampleCN: 这场争执以庭外和解告终。
senses.why: If a transaction is something driven through, a dispute driven to an end is the same act applied to conflict.
senses.whyCN: 若 transaction 是把事情推到完结，那么把争执推到完结，就是同一动作用在冲突上。

senses.title: One unit of work in computing
senses.definition: a set of database operations that must all succeed or all fail together
senses.definitionCN: 一组必须全部成功或全部回退的数据库操作
senses.example: If the network drops, the transaction is rolled back.
senses.exampleCN: 如果网络中断，这笔事务就会被回退。
senses.why: Computing borrows the word for a deal because a database operation must also be carried through completely.
senses.whyCN: 计算机借用这个「买卖」词，因为数据库操作同样必须完整办成。

intro.en: The word is built on Latin trans-, across, and agere, to drive or do, so that a transaction is literally something driven through.
intro.cn: 本词由拉丁语 trans-（穿过）与 agere（推动、做）构成，字面就是「被推行到底的事」。

items.en: Agere means to drive, lead, or do, and supplies the -act- seen in many English words.
items.cn: 拉丁语 agere 意为驱赶、带领、做，提供英语许多词中的 -act- 部分。

items.en: Transigere means to drive through, to settle a matter, or to come to terms with someone.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transigere 意为推行通过、把事情了结、与人达成条件。

items.en: The noun transactio names the settling or the carrying out of a matter.
items.cn: 名词 transactio 指事情的了结或办理。

items.en: French transaction keeps the sense of a settlement or an arrangement between parties.
items.cn: 法语 transaction 保留了双方了结或达成安排的含义。

items.en: English takes the word in the fifteenth century for the doing of business, and the commercial sense of a deal grows dominant.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入该词，指办理事务，随后「一笔买卖」的商业含义逐渐占主导。

items.en: Banking and later computing give the word its modern technical life as a counted, recorded entry.
items.cn: 银行业以及后来的计算机领域，使这个词获得「可计数、可记录条目」的现代技术生命。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -act- stem and the trans- prefix, while the near-meaning group gathers words for deals, sales, and financial records.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -act- 词干与 trans- 前缀，近义组汇集表示交易、销售与财务记录的词。

entries.definition: to carry out a piece of business
a person or firm that carries out a deal
relating to dealings or exchanges
the doing of something
an agreement or a bargain between two sides
the act of giving one thing and receiving another
the act of buying something
an amount of money paid

normalIntro.en: Break the word into trans- and -act- and the meaning follows almost by itself.
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆成 trans- 与 -act-，词义几乎自己就出来了。

normal.en: Trans- means across, so every deal carries something from one side to the other.
normal.cn: trans- 表示「跨过」，每笔交易都把东西从一方带到另一方。

normal.en: The -act- part is act, the same as in action, so a transaction is an act done through.
normal.cn: 其中 -act- 就是 act，与 action 同源，所以 transaction 是一个「办到底的动作」。

normal.en: Compare agere words you already know: agent, agenda, action, all about doing.
normal.cn: 对比你已认识的 agere 词族：agent、agenda、action，都与「做」有关。

normal.en: In a bank the word is used for a single line of money moving, which is a deal in miniature.
normal.cn: 在银行里这个词指一行钱的进出，也就是一笔缩小的买卖。

normal.en: The verb transact is the same word without the noun ending, which proves the pair.
normal.cn: 动词 transact 就是去掉名词词尾的同形词，这组配对可以互相印证。

abstract.en: Picture two hands across a wooden counter, one pushing a document, the other pushing money.
abstract.cn: 想象隔着木柜台的双手，一只推出文件，一只推过钞票。

abstract.en: Feel the counter as a boundary, because the word always crosses something.
abstract.cn: 把柜台当成一道界限，因为这个词总是跨过点什么。

abstract.en: Then hear the printer spit out one line, the record of that single crossing.
abstract.cn: 再听打印机吐出一行字，记录这一次跨越。

examples.en: The transaction was completed in less than a minute.
examples.cn: 这笔交易不到一分钟就完成了。

examples.en: Keep every transaction record for at least three years.
examples.cn: 每笔交易的记录至少要保存三年。

examples.en: They agreed to settle the matter by a quiet transaction out of court.
examples.cn: 他们同意以低调的庭外和解了断此事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿再克实」——穿过去把事办扎实，就是一笔交易。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ agere（推动；做），其名词 transactio 经法语进入英语；同族有 act、action、agent

sensesIntro.en: The senses fan out from one picture, something driven across a boundary and carried to completion, whether a sale, an official matter, or a logged entry.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项从一幅画面展开：跨过界限并被办到底的事，无论是买卖、公务还是记账条目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two parties across a counter, each pushing something through to the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：隔着柜台的两方，各自把东西推到对方手里。

branches.en: The commercial family: a sale, and the ongoing dealings between two parties.
branches.cn: 商业一族：一次买卖，以及两方之间的持续往来。

branches.en: The procedural sense, where the word still means simply finishing a piece of business.
branches.cn: 程序义：这个词仍只表示把一件事办完。

branches.en: The bookkeeping sense, where the written line takes the name of the act.
branches.cn: 记账义：写下的那一行承接了这个动作的名称。

branches.en: The settlement sense, where conflict is driven through to an end.
branches.cn: 了结义：把冲突推到终结。

branches.en: The technical sense, where computing borrows the word for an all-or-nothing operation.
branches.cn: 技术义：计算机借用此词指全成或全退的操作。

intro.en: The word splits cleanly into a Latin prefix and a Latin stem, and both are still productive in English.
intro.cn: 这个词可以干净地拆成拉丁前缀与拉丁词干，两者在英语中仍能产。

latinIntro.en: Trans- and agere are among the most productive Latin pieces in English, appearing in hundreds of words.
latinIntro.cn: trans- 与 agere 是英语中最能产的拉丁部件之一，出现在数百个词里。

items.example: Transport carries goods across a distance.
items.exampleCN: transport 把货物运过一段距离。

items.example: The stem gives act and agent.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干生出 act 与 agent。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词后缀
items.example: Act gives action, and transact gives transaction.
items.exampleCN: act 生 action，transact 生 transaction。

items.example: They transacted the sale in one afternoon.
items.exampleCN: 他们一下午就办成了这笔买卖。

items.example: The goods were in transit for a week.
Transfer the money to the new account.
The agent signed on behalf of the firm.
items.exampleCN: 代理人代表公司签了字。

items.example: The agenda lists five items.
